title: SALES OPERATIONS EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT — $1,000–$1,500 USD PER MONTH
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Long-Term Role



Salary: $1,000 per month starting, $1,500 per month after 90-day probation

Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



You will work directly with the Setter Manager inside a fast-growing online coaching company.

This is a hands-on Executive Assistant role focused on sales operations and oversight.



You will start by shadowing him closely, learn how he works, and quickly take ownership of reporting, CRM checks, SOP compliance, and daily oversight of the setter team.

We need someone who can hit the ground running and take ownership quickly.



WORK SCHEDULE



- 40 hours per week (may start lighter during training)

- Current: Work within 10 AM–8 PM UK time window

- Starting January 2027: Shift to EST and other timezones (Colombia to South Africa range)

- Flexibility required as the Setter Manager travels and business scales



ABOUT US



Freedom Business Mentoring



We help coaches, consultants, and service providers build profitable online businesses using social media and a proven sales framework.



The company scaled to multi-million revenue in under 12 months and has helped hundreds of clients build six-figure businesses.



BENEFITS



- Stable full-time role

- Direct work with sales leadership

- Long-term growth opportunity

- Exposure to sales operations and performance systems

- Opportunity to grow into Quality Control or Sales Ops leadership

- Access to paid AI tools and software. If needed, personal subscriptions will be reimbursed upon invoice submission.

- 15 days paid time off per year

- 15 days paid sick leave per year



TASKS



- Review setters’ end-of-day reports

- Check sales trackers, call notes, and KPIs

- Flag missing data or process gaps

- Keep the CRM clean and updated

- Review sales-to-coaching handoff notes

- Learn and improve internal SOPs

- Use Google Sheets, Excel, and AI to improve systems

- Follow up with setters via WhatsApp and Slack when needed

- Support inbox and calendar management over time

- Build and maintain automated workflows using AI and tools to eliminate manual work

- Help systemize and automate repeat tasks

- Gradually take over more operational and light personal tasks



This role is detail-heavy and output-focused. Accuracy, speed, and ownership are required.



REQUIREMENTS



- Experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, or Coordinator supporting a leader

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

- Confident using AI tools to improve workflows and systems

- Experience building or improving automated workflows and processes

- Strong written and spoken English

- Highly organized and proactive

- Comfortable working with KPIs and sales performance metrics

- Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment

- Comfortable being on video calls during training and shadowing



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE (FIRST 90 DAYS)



By 90 days, you should:



- Fully understand the Setter Manager’s workflow and priorities

- Independently manage daily reporting and CRM checks

- Proactively identify issues before they are escalated

- Reliably execute tasks once given a clear SOP

- Reduce the amount of admin and oversight the Setter Manager handles daily



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Experience working in a sales team

- Familiarity with Close CRM, Slack, or PandaDoc

- Basic understanding of automation tools



Apply here:



Important note: In the Name field, write SALES OPS EA + Your First and Last Name.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: AI Ads Video Editor (Direct Response /Facebook Ads)
description:
AI META ADS VIDEO EDITOR - DIRECT RESPONSE (D2C BABY BRAND)



Please read the whole post before applying. Applications that skip the questions at the bottom are not reviewed.



ABOUT US



We are LUNA, a D2C baby brand. Our first product is a sleep cocoon that holds a newborn's arms so the startle reflex stops waking him every 45 minutes. Our customers are exhausted first-time mothers who have already tried two or three products that failed, and who quietly believe the problem is them. Our whole brand exists to prove it isn't.



We are scaling on Meta and we need a video editor who understands direct response, not just editing.



THE ROLE



You will create and edit ads for
 and Instagram: top-funnel scroll-stoppers, UGC-style mother testimonials, founder ads, mechanism/education ads, bottom-funnel conversion ads, and AI-assisted creatives.



You need to understand what makes an ad convert, not just what looks nice. Hooks, clean cuts, pacing, scroll-stopping visuals, subtitles, benefit stacking, social proof, CTAs, and variations that actually isolate one variable.



You should also be very good with AI tools and know how to use AI to produce better and faster ad content.



WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM MOST EDITING ROLES



Read this part carefully. It is the difference between an application we reply to and one we do not.



1. We sell an emotion, not an object. The product almost never leads. What she is buying is the feeling of being a calm, capable mother again. The product appears late and briefly, as proof. If your instinct is to open on a hero product shot, this is not your role.



2. We do not sell with fear. This is a baby category. Anxiety-bait and danger framing are banned here. They convert short term and destroy a trust brand. Our angle is absolution: it's not you, you were never the problem.



3. Trust is the whole product. Uncanny AI, fake-looking mothers, AI-generated infants, or anything that reads as synthetic will kill performance faster than a weak hook. You need the judgement to know where AI helps (b-roll, upscaling, voiceover, variation speed, motion, mockups, cleanup) and where it destroys credibility (the mother's face, the baby, the testimonial).



4. We advertise in non-English markets. Our main market is Sweden, with Spanish-language assets alongside it. You do not need to speak the language. You do need to be obsessive about pasting our locked terminology exactly as written, never improving a subtitle you cannot read, and catching when an AI caption tool has mangled a word.



5. Meta's rules bite harder here. Copy implying a personal attribute ("you look exhausted", "your baby won't sleep") and unapproved health or safety claims get creatives rejected. You should already know how to land the same emotional punch without triggering a rejection.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Editing Meta ads for
 and Instagram

- Creating high-converting UGC-style mother testimonial ads

- Editing founder ads and spokesperson-style ads

- Cutting mechanism/education ads that make an invisible problem visible

- Creating bottom-funnel ads focused on conversions

- Turning raw clips, customer footage and stock into polished ad creatives

- Using AI tools to improve video ads and speed up production

- Adding subtitles, hooks, overlays, benefits, effects, transitions and CTAs

- Creating multiple ad variations for testing: hook, first frame, CTA

- Repurposing winning creatives into new versions and new angles

- Working fast and delivering new creatives consistently

- Communicating clearly with the team and thinking creatively about new angles



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong experience editing Meta ads for D2C brands

- Understands
 and Instagram ad creative, and Meta ad policy in practice

- Experience with UGC ads, founder ads, product ads and bottom-funnel ads

- Very comfortable with AI video tools, and knows when not to use them

- Understands hooks, angles, CTAs, social proof, urgency, benefits and objections

- Can create ads made to convert, not just look beautiful

- Can hold an emotional tone without it turning sentimental or dramatic

- Meticulous with foreign-language on-screen text; follows a terminology sheet exactly

- Speaks and writes good English

- Full time, 40 hours per week, with some overlap with European hours

- Reliable, fast, consistent, high EQ, works well with feedback

- Takes ownership and does not need constant hand-holding

- Wants long-term job security, stable income, and to grow inside the company



A background in parenting, health, beauty or any other trust-led emotional category is a strong plus.



AI TOOLS - EXPERIENCE WITH ANY OF THESE IS A PLUS



Higgsfield, Runway, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Midjourney, ChatGPT, Claude, Descript, OpusClip, Topaz, Canva AI, or any other AI video, voice or image tool.



AD EDITING SKILLS



You should understand how to edit with strong hooks that land in the first 3 seconds muted as text, fast pacing that still keeps an emotional beat, pattern interrupts, captions and subtitles, product benefits, objection handling, before/after structures, founder storytelling, UGC testimonial structure, social proof, clear CTAs, and bottom-funnel conversion focus.



IMPORTANT



This is not a basic video editing role. You should be able to look at an ad and explain why it works or why it does not.



You will be editing for real mothers at their lowest point, so we care as much about your judgement and taste as your timeline skills.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Stable monthly pay, paid on time, every time

- Long-term role with a clear raise after 90 days on hitting the quality and output bar

- Performance bonuses when creatives win

- Direct access to the founder, no layers of middle management

- Real ownership of the creative output of a growing brand



HOW TO APPLY



Answer all 8 questions in your application. Applications without all 8 answers are not reviewed.



1. How many years of Meta ads video editing experience do you have?

2. Which D2C brands have you worked with before?

3. Send your best Meta ad examples.

4. Send examples of UGC ads or founder ads you edited.

5. What AI tools do you use, and what do you deliberately NOT use AI for?

6. Do you understand bottom-funnel ad creatives? Explain briefly.

7. What editing software do you use?

8. Here is a hook: "I thought I was a bad mother. Turns out I had the wrong swaddle." In 2-3 sentences, how would you cut the first 5 seconds of that ad?



Start your application with the word COCOON so we know you read the full post.



Shortlisted candidates get a small PAID test edit before we make an offer. We pay for your time.

title: Layout Designer (Publishing)
description:
Layout Designer (Part-Time)

Location: Remote

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week 





We're Hiring!



We're looking for a highly detail-oriented Layout Designer to join our growing creative team.

This role is ideal for someone with experience in editorial design, magazines, brochures, catalogs, coffee table books, or other publication layouts. You'll work within professionally designed Canva templates to produce polished, luxury-quality portfolios and digital magazines for real estate professionals.

This isn't a role where you'll be creating designs from scratch. Instead, you'll focus on bringing templates to life through thoughtful layout execution, image sourcing, content organization, and maintaining a premium visual experience from beginning to end.

As our company grows, this position has the potential to evolve into a long-term, full-time creative role.



What You'll Do

Build high-quality client portfolios using existing Canva templates

Create matching digital magazines that complement each printed portfolio

Source high-quality images that align with each client's location, branding, and target audience

Maintain consistent spacing, alignment, grids, and overall visual hierarchy throughout every project

Customize layouts using each client's brand colors while preserving the overall design system

Replace and organize content within templates while ensuring every page feels cohesive

Assist with light copy adaptation using AI tools and provided prompts when needed

Perform detailed quality assurance before projects are finalized

Collaborate closely with our team to continuously improve efficiency while maintaining design quality



What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who has an exceptional eye for layout and understands that great design is often about precision, consistency, and attention to detail.

You should have:

Experience designing magazines, brochures, editorial layouts, catalogs, coffee table books, annual reports, or similar publications

Advanced Canva experience

Strong understanding of layout composition, spacing, alignment, grids, and typography

Excellent image selection and visual storytelling skills

Strong attention to detail and consistency across multi-page documents

Ability to follow brand guidelines and existing templates precisely

Experience working with luxury, premium, or high-end branding is a plus

Ability to work independently while following creative direction



Bonus Qualifications

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

Editorial or publication design

Real estate marketing materials

AI image generation tools (such as ChatGPT)

AI-assisted copywriting workflows

Basic copy editing

Experience working with design systems or brand guidelines



Tools You'll Use

Canva (primary design platform)

ChatGPT (for image generation and light copy adaptation)

Google Workspace

Internal templates and creative assets



Who You Are

We're looking for someone who:

Has an exceptional eye for clean, organized layouts

Notices the smallest alignment and spacing inconsistencies

Understands visual balance and negative space

Can source imagery that feels authentic and cohesive

Follows creative direction while taking ownership of execution

Enjoys producing polished, premium-quality work

Is dependable, organized, and committed to delivering consistent results

title: Social Media Customer Support & Community Specialist
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA CUSTOMER SUPPORT & COMMUNITY SPECIALIST – REMOTE

US E-commerce Health & Wellness Brand



Work from home | Full-time | US business hours



We are looking for an experienced Social Media Customer Support & Community Specialist to engage with customers across social media and online-review platforms.



Your primary responsibility will be responding to customer comments, direct messages, complaints, and reviews while protecting the brand’s online reputation and creating a positive customer experience.



This is a customer-support and community-care role. It is not primarily focused on content creation, graphic design, social media posting, paid advertising, or lead generation.



Key Responsibilities

Monitor and respond to customer comments and direct messages across
, Instagram, TikTok, and other assigned platforms

Assist customers with product questions, orders, shipping, refunds, replacements, cancellations, subscriptions, and account concerns

Respond professionally and empathetically to complaints and negative public feedback

Move sensitive or account-specific concerns from public comments to private messages,
, or another appropriate support channel

Monitor and respond to reviews on Trustpilot, Google Reviews, Loox, and similar platforms

Help resolve customer concerns while protecting the company’s online reputation

Follow approved brand messaging, communication guidelines, and escalation procedures

Escalate urgent, sensitive, or complex cases to the appropriate team

Encourage satisfied customers to share reviews, testimonials, or feedback when appropriate

Identify recurring customer concerns and report relevant trends or customer sentiment to management

Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, escalations, and resolutions

Coordinate with the Customer Support, Retention, and Operations teams when necessary

Required Qualifications

At least two years of relevant experience in social media customer support, community care, customer service, or online reputation management

Recent hands-on experience responding to both public social media comments and direct messages

Experience handling complaints, escalations, and negative public feedback

Experience moving customer concerns from public conversations to private support channels

Experience assisting customers with orders, shipping, refunds, replacements, cancellations, or subscriptions

Strong written English with the ability to adjust tone based on the customer and situation

Calm, professional, and empathetic communication style

Good judgment when responding publicly on behalf of a brand

Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of interactions

Ability to work independently and consistently during US business hours

Strongly Preferred

Recent customer-support experience with a US-based DTC e-commerce brand

Experience with Trustpilot, Google Reviews, Loox, or similar review platforms

Shopify, WooCommerce, or another e-commerce platform

Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze, Intercom, Help Scout, or a similar support platform

Meta Business Suite or other social media management tools

Experience with health, wellness, supplement, beauty, or subscription-based brands

Experience monitoring customer sentiment, recurring complaints, and community trends

Important Role Clarification



This position may not be the right fit if your experience is primarily in:



Content creation and social media posting

Graphic design or video editing

Social media marketing and campaign planning

Influencer marketing

Lead generation or appointment setting

Meta Ads or other paid advertising



These skills may be helpful, but they do not replace direct experience handling customer comments, DMs, complaints, and online reviews.



Remote Work Requirements

Reliable computer suitable for full-time remote work

Stable internet connection of at least 50 Mbps

Backup internet connection

Quiet and professional home workspace

Backup plan for power interruptions

Availability to work full-time during US business hours

Compensation



USD 700–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and qualifications.

title: Static Ad Designer
description:
MHI Media is a UK-based e-commerce performance marketing agency that has scaled 50+ DTC brands to 7 and 8 figures. We're looking for a skilled Graphic Designer to join our creative team and produce high-converting static ad creatives for paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Google, and more.



What You'll Be Doing:

• Designing scroll-stopping static ad creatives for DTC e-commerce brands

• Producing a high volume of ad variations — new concepts, iterations, and format adaptations (target: 40+ creatives per client per month)

• Working from creative briefs provided by strategists — translating hooks, angles, and offers into compelling visual designs

• Creating text-heavy statics, product mockups, lifestyle-style ads, comparison graphics, listicles, and offer-led creatives

• Adapting winning ad formats and frameworks for different brands and products

title: Social Media & Content Manager — Luxury Mountain Property (Boulder, Colorado)
description:
# Social Media & Content Manager — Luxury Mountain Property (Boulder, Colorado)



**PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific application instructions inside, and applications that don't follow them will not be reviewed.**



---



## About the property



The Rusty Skillet Ranch is a luxury mountain home and day spa outside Boulder, Colorado, set in the Fourmile Canyon. It took ten years to design and build. It has a hot tub, a cedar sauna, and hundreds of five-star reviews.



Until now, nearly all of our bookings have come through Airbnb. We've just launched our own direct booking website, and we want to shift the mix. Our goal is to grow bookings roughly 30% in 2027, with the growth coming through our own channels rather than the platforms.



This is a single property, not a portfolio. You'll go deep rather than wide — you'll know this house, this canyon, and these guests better than anyone.



## About the role



This is a part-time role, 10 to 12 hours per week, focused on one thing: making this property impossible to scroll past.



You'll own our organic social presence end to end. We handle the property itself (we have a property manager for cleaning, turnovers, and guest logistics) and we handle the ad accounts and budget. You handle content and community.



You'll report directly to the owner. Small operation, no committees, no layers of approval.



## What you'll be responsible for



**Instagram and short-form video (the core of the job)**



- Own the content calendar and post consistently: 3–5 Reels per week plus daily Stories

- Edit vertical short-form video from a large existing library of footage, plus new material we capture on site

- Cut for hooks — under 90 seconds, strong open in the first three seconds, natural rather than over-produced

- Focus on lived-experience content: the sauna door opening into falling snow, coffee on the deck at sunrise, the drive up the canyon. Not real-estate walkthroughs

- Write captions built around Instagram search keywords rather than hashtag spam

- Respond to comments and DMs quickly, and turn DM inquiries into booking-site visits



**Community and partnerships**



- Engage daily with Boulder-area accounts: restaurants, guides, outfitters, local travel pages

- Propose and coordinate collaborations and giveaways with local businesses

- Run a guest UGC program — branded hashtag, reposting, guest features



**Light paid support**



- When a Reel performs well organically, boost it from within Instagram with a small budget we set

- You will not be managing our Meta or Google ad accounts. We run those. If that grows into part of the role later, it will come with a raise



**Reporting**



- A short weekly note: what you posted, what performed, what you're changing

- Track saves, shares, DM sends, and profile taps — not likes

- Flag which content drives traffic to the booking site



## What we're looking for



**Required**



- 2+ years managing social media for a brand, property, or business, with accounts you can show us

- Strong short-form video editing (CapCut, Premiere, or equivalent) and a genuine eye for beautiful places

- Excellent written English — you'll be writing captions and talking to guests in our voice

- Reliable, self-directed, and communicative. We're not going to assign you daily tasks

- Some overlap with US Mountain Time hours for posting and DM response



**Nice to have**



- Experience with short-term rentals, vacation rentals, hospitality, or travel

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or Google Ads (useful later, not required now)

- Photography or design background (Canva, Figma, Lightroom)

- An interest in the outdoors, design, or hospitality — you'll do better work if you actually like this



## How to apply



Send us:



1. A short note on why this role interests you specifically

2. Links to two or three social accounts you've managed, and what you grew them from and to

3. Two examples of short-form video you edited yourself

4. Your available hours in US Mountain Time



**To confirm you've read this posting in full, put "The Rusty Skillet" in your subject line.** Applications without it won't be opened.



Then tell us, in one sentence, what you'd post first if you got this job. We're more interested in your thinking than your resume.



## Hours and compensation



**$500 USD per month** for 10–12 hours per week.



**Plus 5% of every new direct booking you help drive.** Our nightly rates are high, so this is meaningful money — a single booking bonus can be $75–150. Consistent performance can double your monthly income.



The bonus terms, plainly:



- Applies to new guests, or returning guests who last stayed 12 or more months ago

- Calculated on accommodation revenue, excluding cleaning fees and taxes

- Paid after the stay is completed, not at time of booking

- Reviewed at 12 months, so we can restructure it as the channel grows



We pay on time, every time, in full. We start with a paid trial project before either of us commits to anything longer.



## What working with us is like



We value people who take ownership, communicate proactively when something isn't working, and care about doing good work. If you need to be told what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you've been waiting for someone to hand you a beautiful property and get out of your way, it might be.

title: Ecommerce Video Editor (VSLS/SHORT FORM)
description:
# Expert eCommerce Direct-Response Video Editor — Meta Ads



**Remote | Full-Time or Contract**



We are a rapidly scaling eCommerce brand seeking an expert-level **Direct-Response Video Editor** to create high-converting Meta ad creatives.



This role is specifically for editors who specialize in **eCommerce VSLs and paid social advertising**. If direct-response eCommerce editing is not a core part of your daily work, this position will not be the right fit.



## Role Overview



Your primary responsibility will be editing **2–5 minute VSL-style Meta ads designed to generate purchases**.



You will also create short-form ad formats, including:



* Claymation-style creatives

* Pixar-style creatives

* Skeleton and anatomy-based creatives

* AI-generated UGC

* Product demonstrations

* Other emerging direct-response formats



Our goal is not simply to create visually appealing videos. Every creative must be built to capture attention, maintain retention, communicate value, and drive conversions.



## Direct-Response Structure



You should be experienced in editing ads built around frameworks such as:



* Problem

* Agitation

* Authority

* Discovery

* Unique mechanism

* Product introduction

* Benefits

* Social proof

* Testimonials

* Offer

* Scarcity

* Call to action



You must understand how to visually reinforce every line of a script and maintain viewer attention throughout the entire advertisement.



## Creative Style



Our preferred editing style includes:



* Documentary-style visuals

* Limited reliance on generic stock footage

* AI-generated B-roll

* AI-generated UGC

* 3D product and mechanism animations

* Dynamic captions

* Motion graphics

* Split-screen layouts

* Callouts and annotations

* Red circles, arrows, and visual emphasis

* Product proof and demonstration elements

* Fast-paced editing

* Frequent pattern interrupts

* Strategic sound design and visual effects



Problem-focused sections should feel emotional, tense, frustrating, and relatable.



Benefit-focused sections should feel aspirational, positive, hopeful, and transformational.



## AI Content Generation



You will be expected to create and incorporate AI-generated assets using tools such as:



* Freepik

* HeyGen

* Higgsfield

* Kling

* Similar AI video and image-generation platforms



You should be comfortable producing:



* AI actors

* AI-generated UGC

* AI B-roll

* AI environments

* AI product demonstrations

* Product mechanism visuals

* 3D visual explanations

* Custom scenes based on script requirements



Strong prompting skills and the ability to generate consistent, realistic assets are required.



## Responsibilities



* Edit 2–5 minute direct-response VSLs for Meta advertising

* Create multiple hook and creative variations from winning concepts

* Produce one complete VSL package per day

* Generate AI visuals and supporting assets when necessary

* Incorporate existing brand footage, product imagery, testimonials, and creative assets

* Add captions, motion graphics, sound design, visual effects, and pattern interrupts

* Rapidly implement feedback and creative revisions

* Deliver high-quality creatives consistently and on schedule

* Help improve hooks, watch time, retention, click-through rates, and conversion rates

* Maintain organized project files and creative versions



## Required Experience



You must have extensive experience with:



* eCommerce VSL editing

* Meta and
 advertising

* Direct-response marketing

* Hook development

* Retention-focused editing

* Visual storytelling

* CTA placement

* Conversion-focused creative strategy

* AI-generated content

* High-volume creative production



You must be capable of producing creatives quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality.



## Production Expectations



For short-form content, the expected output is:



* **Four 60-second videos per day**



For VSL content, the expected output is:



* **One 3–4 minute VSL per day**

* Each VSL package should include:



  * One main body

  * Five hook variations



You must be able to meet daily deadlines and maintain consistent communication.



## Portfolio Requirements



To be considered, you must submit:



* Your portfolio

* Multiple eCommerce VSLs that you personally edited

* Examples of creatives used for Meta advertising

* Examples featuring AI-generated content

* Your availability for an interview in Eastern Time



Applications without relevant eCommerce direct-response examples will not be considered.

**apple**

title: Google Ads Specialist
description:
Part-Time Google Ads Account Manager (Remote)



You'll work directly with the founder. All client calls and client relationships are handled by us — your job is to make the accounts perform.



The Role



You'll manage a portfolio of Google Ads accounts end to end. This is hands-on account management, not admin support. You should be comfortable opening an account you've never seen before, diagnosing what's wrong, and fixing it.



Weekly rhythm



Account checks across your portfolio (campaign performance, anomalies, disapprovals, tracking issues) — flag anything unusual

Budget pacing reviews twice weekly — make sure spend is on track for the month, adjust where needed

Negative keyword reviews from search term reports

Weekly internal report + short Loom walkthrough per account, delivered Monday by 10am UK — key metrics and notes in our standard format



Monthly rhythm



Monthly performance report per client, sent by the end of the first week of the month

A/B test launches — at least one new experiment per account per month (ad copy, bidding, landing pages)

Input into strategy — you'll feed recommendations to the founder ahead of client strategy calls



Ongoing



Campaign builds — new campaigns, ad groups, keyword research, ad copy

Conversion tracking setup and troubleshooting (GA4, Google Tag Manager, offline conversions)

Search term and query analysis

Landing page audits with flagged recommendations

Bing/Microsoft Ads management where clients run it

Responding to internal requests within agreed turnaround times



What We're Looking For



Proven Google Ads experience managing accounts independently — Search, Performance Max, and ideally Shopping

Strong with conversion tracking: GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion actions, debugging broken tracking

Comfortable owning budgets and pacing without being chased

Able to write decent ad copy and structure campaigns properly

Clear written communicator — your weekly reports and Looms are how we stay aligned

Organised and self-managing — you'll run your accounts on a set cadence without reminders

Bonus: Microsoft Ads, Looker Studio, ecommerce/Shopify experience



Details



Part-time to start, with more hours available as the client base grows

Fully remote, flexible working — we care about output, not hours logged

Direct line to the founder, fast decisions, no agency bureaucracy

Clear SOPs and reporting templates provided

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline

- You are low energy or unclear

Fill in the form:

title: Experienced Cold Caller
description:
# Experienced Cold Caller / Appointment Setter



**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | $500 USD/month**



We’re looking for an **experienced, confident, and highly motivated Cold Caller / Appointment Setter** to join our UK client's team on a full-time basis.



This is a **40-hour-per-week position based on UK timing** for someone who is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls, speaking with prospects, handling objections, and consistently booking qualified appointments.



### What You’ll Do



* Make outbound cold calls to prospective customers

* Speak confidently and professionally with prospects

* Follow our calling scripts while keeping conversations natural

* Identify qualified prospects and decision-makers

* Handle common objections and keep conversations moving

* Book qualified appointments for the team

* Accurately update our CRM and call records

* Follow up with prospects when required

* Meet daily and weekly call and appointment targets

* Communicate results, feedback, and challenges to management

* Continuously improve your calling approach based on performance

* Track and takes cold calls via GoHighLevel CRM



### What We’re Looking For



* **2+ years of cold calling / appointment-setting experience preferred**

* Excellent spoken English and clear pronunciation

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills

* Confident speaking with strangers over the phone

* Comfortable handling rejection and objections

* Self-motivated and able to work independently

* Reliable attendance and strong work ethic

* Good organization and attention to detail

* Experience with CRMs, dialers, or lead-management systems is a plus

* Proven ability to hit targets and consistently produce results



### The Right Person



We’re **not looking for someone who simply reads a script**.



We want someone who can have a real conversation, build rapport quickly, ask the right questions, overcome objections, and turn cold prospects into **qualified appointments**.



If you are competitive, persistent, coachable, and take pride in your results, you’ll do very well in this role.



### Compensation



**$500 USD/month base salary**



**40 hours per week**



**Monday to Friday**



Additional **performance bonuses** are available based on results and appointment performance.



There is also potential for increased compensation for consistently strong performers.



### Schedule



Full-time: **40 hours per week**



You must be able to work the required schedule consistently and be available during the hours when our target market is most active.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your **cold calling experience**

2. How many years you have been cold calling

3. The industries you have called for

4. Your typical daily call volume

5. Your appointment-setting results, if available

6. If GHL CRM you have experience with

7. A **1–2 minute voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this position

8. If UK timing 9am-5pm Monday to Friday is fine

9. If you can commit full time

10. If $500 USD per month is OK



**Please do not apply if you do not have cold calling experience.**



We’re looking for someone who wants to become a long-ter
mber of the team and grow with the company.

title: AI Content Creator / AI Editor
description:
Company Overview. BKG is a Dutch home-renovation group with brands including Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and Tegelstudio (tiles), plus 25+ brands in the wider BKG group. We produce a lot of short-form content and need an AI-savvy content maker to add everything that isn’t filmed.



Job Description. You take scripts and edited footage and add what wasn’t shot: AI-generated images, B-roll, backgrounds and infographics. You work after the video-editor in our content chain, under the content captain. Your work spans all three areas — Sanitairstudio, Tegelstudio and the wider BKG group — with the group as the biggest share.



Major Functions.

• Create AI-generated visuals (images, backgrounds, B-roll) that fit a script and brand.

• Build simple infographics and motion/title graphics.

• Source or generate B-roll to fill gaps in filmed material.

• Keep everything on-brand and hand finished assets to the editor/captain.



Required Skills.

• 1+ year making content with AI image/video tools (e.g. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, Kling or similar) with a portfolio.

• Good visual taste; can match a brand look.

• Basic motion/graphics (CapCut / After Effects / Canva) and infographic sense.

• Reliable, fast, good written English.

• Nice-to-have: home/interior visuals, prompt libraries, light editing.



Availability. ~22 hrs/week, flexible, with reliable turnaround.



Expectations. You fill the gaps the camera can’t: when a script needs a visual that wasn’t filmed, you make it — fast, on-brand, and without hand-holding.



Working Conditions / Salary. $438/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as our content output scales.



Bonuses. Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



How to Apply. Start your message with the word “BROLL” so we know you read the full post. Then, briefly:

1. Share 2 examples where you used AI tools to create visuals or B-roll for real content (links). Tell us which tools.

2. In 2–3 sentences: a script needs a shot we never filmed — a wide shot of a finished bathroom. How do you produce a believable, on-brand visual for it?

3. Which AI tools do you reach for first for (a) images and (b) short motion/B-roll, and why?

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

Company Overview. BKG is a Dutch home-renovation group with brands including Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and Tegelstudio (tiles). We produce a lot of short-form content and need a fast editor who turns raw footage into polished, captioned shorts.



Job Description. You edit real footage into Reels / TikTok / Shorts: pacing, captions, music, light motion — keeping a consistent brand look and a fast turnaround. You work after the strategist and before the AI-editor. Your work is split fairly evenly across our bathroom brand (Sanitairstudio), the wider BKG group and our tile brand (Tegelstudio), so you switch between brand looks.



Major Functions.

• Edit raw footage into polished vertical shorts (Reels / TikTok / Shorts).

• Add accurate, well-timed captions (Opus / Submagic) and music.

• Add light motion / title elements; keep a consistent brand look.

• Work from shot lists and keep a fast, reliable turnaround.



Required Skills.

• 2+ years short-form editing with a portfolio.

• Strong pacing and captioning.

• Fast and reliable.

• Good written English.

• Nice-to-have: motion graphics, working from shot lists, B-roll sourcing.



Availability. ~20 hrs/week, flexible, with reliable daily responsiveness for turnaround.



Expectations. You turn footage around quickly without dropping quality: tight pacing, clean captions, on-brand finish. You follow the brief and flag when something’s unusable.



Working Conditions / Salary. $398/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as our content output scales.



Bonuses. Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



How to Apply. Start your message with the word “CUT” so we know you read the full post. Then, briefly:

title: Manual QA Tester - $450/mth
description:
Manual QA Tester - Healthcare Compliance Software (Full-Time, Remote)

Salary: AUD 450/month - 40 hours/week

About us

CareVisor is an AI compliance platform for disability and aged care providers across Australia, the UK, and the US. Our customers use it to stay audit-ready in a heavily regulated sector. When our software breaks, real providers fail real audits. Quality is not a nice-to-have here.

We are hiring a full-time Manual QA Tester to own day-to-day testing across the platform. You are the last line of defence before anything reaches a customer.

What you will do

• Write and execute test cases across web application features

• Run functional, regression, cross-browser, and end-to-end testing on each release

• Log clear, reproducible bug reports with steps, expected vs actual, screenshots, and severity

• Verify fixes and close the loop with engineering

• Test AI-generated outputs for accuracy and consistency, not just whether the button works

• Maintain and grow regression suites as the product expands

• Report quality status each sprint to the product and engineering leads

What we are looking for

• 2+ years in manual software testing, ideally on web applications

• You write bug reports a developer can act on without a single follow-up question

• Comfortable testing complex workflows with multiple user roles and permissions

• Strong written English

• Available and responsive during a consistent daily overlap with the Australian team

• Experience with Jira, TestRail, or similar

Nice to have

• Exposure to healthcare, compliance, or other regulated software

• Basic API testing (Postman)

• Interest in moving toward test automation

The setup

• Full-time, long-term engagement

• 450 per month, paid monthly

• Independent contractor arrangement

• Fully remote, you provide your own computer and internet

• Schedule and daily overlap agreed with you on the call

Why this one is worth your time

We are a small team shipping fast across three markets. You will not be one of twelve testers assigned to a single screen. You will see the whole product, your bug reports will change what gets built, and you will work directly with the engineering and product leads. As we grow, this role grows into test automation and QA process ownership.

How to apply

Send your CV plus:

1. A bug report you have written before (redact anything confidential), or a sample bug report for any web app you use regularly

2. One sentence on the worst bug you ever caught before it reached production

Start your application with the word REGRESSION so we know you read this properly. Applications without the bug report sample will not be reviewed.

Google Workspace (Gmail suite) , Monday, Canva.

Most of your work involves data entry using AI tools, along with general operations support — uploading, scheduling, research, coordination, and whatever else keeps things running smoothly. • Clear communication skills in English



Nice to have

What we're not looking for

title: Graphic Designer  &  Video Editor
description:
About the role



We are looking for a creative, fast, and detail-oriented Graphic Designer  &  Video Editor to support our beauty brand across TikTok, Instagram, Meta ads, Shopee, website, and retail campaigns.



This role is ideal for someone who understands short-form video, social media trends, ad creatives, beauty/wellness content, and graphic design. You will help turn product benefits, customer reviews, founder content, influencer videos, and campaign ideas into high-performing content that drives awareness, clicks, and sales.



Key responsibilities



1. Video editing

Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Meta ads, Shopee, and website use.

Create strong opening hooks, captions, subtitles, transitions, overlays, product callouts, before/after style edits, UGC-style edits, and founder-led content edits.



2. Ad creative production

Create conversion-focused ad creatives based on briefs from the performance marketing team.

Produce multiple versions of the same concept with different hooks, captions, thumbnails, angles, and CTAs for testing.



3. Graphic design

Design packaging, social media posts, ad graphics, story slides, product education carousels, Shopee/Lazada banners, website banners, promo visuals, and simple campaign assets.



4. Content planning support

Support the team with weekly content calendars, creative ideas, campaign concepts, hooks, trending formats, and competitor inspiration.

Help organize content by product, campaign, platform, audience, and funnel stage.



5. Creative research and Brand Development

Research winning TikTok, Meta, Shopee, beauty, wellness, and supplement ads.

Save references and suggest how we can adapt them for Dr. Ora in a brand-safe and premium way.



Requirements



Minimum 4 years of experience in video editing, social media content, graphic design, or creative production.

Strong skills in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar tools.

Good sense of TikTok/Reels pacing, hooks, subtitles, and visual storytelling.

Able to design clean, premium, beauty-focused graphics.

Understands e-commerce, social media ads, and performance creative testing.

title: AI & Automation Implementation Specialist
description:
External / Contract / Fractional



BOSS MGMT GRP



BOSS MGMT GRP is seeking an experienced AI & Automation Implementation Specialist to help us land and optimise a major systems transition already underway.



This is not a theoretical advisory role, and it is not a build-from-scratch role. We are mid-build on a bespoke internal platform (CRM, roster, outreach, contracts, finance) that is replacing HubSpot entirely by October 2026. We need a highly capable external specialist who can audit how the business actually works day to day, close the gap between that reality and the new platform, and make sure the rollout is adopted, governed, and actually used, not just shipped.



You will work closely with leadership to improve the efficiency, intelligence, and scalability of our operations across creator management, brand partnerships, outreach, onboarding, CRM, internal knowledge, reporting, and administrative workflows, with the platform transition as the immediate priority.



If you are someone who knows how to move from strategy to execution and from ideas to live systems, we want to hear from you.



About BOSS MGMT GRP



BOSS MGMT GRP is a creator and influencer marketing agency operating across multiple global markets, with a strong focus on commercial representation, operational excellence, and scalable systems that support both internal teams and external partners.



We are mid-transition from HubSpot to a proprietary operating system covering CRM, roster, outreach sequencing, contracts, and finance. This role sits alongside that build, not inside it.



The Role



We are looking for an external specialist to help us:



- audit current workflows, tools, and operational bottlenecks against the new platform's capabilities

- identify gaps between how the business runs today and how it needs to run on the new system

- own the practical mechanics of the HubSpot-to-platform migration (data, process, sequencing, team habits)

- recommend and help configure the remaining integrations (Gmail API, PandaDoc, Xero, Airwallex, and WhatsApp Business API as a conditional fast-follow)

- improve internal efficiency, visibility, documentation, and execution

- drive adoption and governance of the new systems across the business; this is the part that determines whether the build actually pays off



Key Responsibilities



- run a workflow and tooling audit, flag what won't survive the migration as-is

- map current CRM/outreach/contract/finance processes to the new platform's modules

- lead the operational side of the HubSpot cutover: parallel-run management, data migration integrity, cancellation timing

configure and govern integrations across Gmail, Google Docs/Drive, PandaDoc, Xero, and Airwallex

- assess WhatsApp Business API feasibility (Meta verification, template approval, dedicated number) as a fast-follow, not a blocker

- build documentation, SOPs, and training materials for the team

- train internal staff on the new platform and retire old habits/tools cleanly

- identify further AI and automation opportunities once the core transition is stable



Areas of Focus



- platform migration and cutover management

- CRM and data process optimisation

- outreach and follow-up automation (Gmail-native sequencing)

- integration governance (PandaDoc, Xero, Airwallex, WhatsApp)

- document and knowledge management

- process documentation and system governance

- team training and change management



What We're Looking For



- proven experience leading system migrations, not just implementing net-new tools

- strong systems thinking and process design capability

- experience working across operations, CRM, and business automation

- the ability to assess messy or fragmented workflows and turn them into clean, scalable systems

- hands-on implementation experience, not just advisory experience

- strong communication skills and the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and a separate development team

- a commercial mindset with clear judgement around practicality, efficiency, and ROI

- comfort working to a hard external deadline (October 2026)



Ideal Experience



- CRM migrations (HubSpot to a custom/internal platform, or equivalent)

- automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar

- Google Workspace ecosystems, Gmail API

- PandaDoc, Xero, or Airwallex integration experience

- internal knowledge systems and AI-assisted search

- process mapping and SOP creation

- systems integration and rollout

- team enablement and change management



What Success Looks Like



- HubSpot fully decommissioned by 30 October 2026 with no operational gap

- the team actually using the new platform, not falling back to old habits

- integrations (Gmail, PandaDoc, Xero, Airwallex) live and reliable

- reduced manual admin and operational friction

- clean documentation and a governance model that outlasts the engagement



Engagement Structure



External contract or fractional engagement, with an initial focus on audit and migration execution against the 30 September deadline, extending into ongoing AI/automation opportunities once the transition is stable. Open to project-based, retained, or phased structures.



To Apply



Please send through:

- examples of AI and automation work you have implemented

Fully Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Position



Do you enjoy building relationships, working with creators, and helping grow one of the fastest-growing marketing channels in e-commerce?



Ella Bella is an established hair tools and hair care brand with a strong presence on Amazon. As we continue expanding across TikTok Shop, Shopify, Walmart, and other platforms, we're looking for someone to help grow and manage our creator and affiliate partnerships.



Our main focus is TikTok Shop, but we're also open to building creator and affiliate partnerships across other platforms.



Affiliate marketing experience is a plus, but not required. We're more focused on finding someone who has excellent attention to detail, strong written communication skills, good judgment, and the ability to work independently.

mbers

title: TECHNICAL Client ONBOARDING SPECIALIST
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form:



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: CPA
description:
The CPA will be responsible for the reconciliation and management of internal accounts, assist the Assistant Finance Manager with daily accounting tasks such as updating internal system information with new data, communicating important and necessary information to the team, manage and execute daily transactions. The incumbent will also assist in the annual filings, file monthly reconciliations, and maintain electronic files and folders.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Property Financial Oversight 

Manage all financial operations for assigned properties on behalf of the landlord.

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



 2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management 

Monitor tenant accounts and process rent collections.

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.



3. Vendor & Expense Management 

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.



4. Reporting

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.



5. Cash Flow Management 

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.





6. Compliance & Documentation 

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



 7. Coordination & Escalation 

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

CPA

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

Ability to display absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive information

Ability to take initiative to identify, prioritize and implement all elements required for the team to fulfill responsibilities

Ability to work well under pressure and effectively handle multiple, concurrent demands and appropriately prioritize responsibilities

Quickbooks experience IS A MUST

mbers are updating the same QuickBooks or Excel file?

This role will focus mainly on preparing U.S. individual income tax returns, organizing client documents, communicating with clients, and helping tax engagements move smoothly through the filing process.



The ideal candidate has experience preparing or assisting with U.S. individual tax returns and wants to continue building their tax knowledge while working closely with an experienced CPA.



Key Responsibilities



Tax Preparation



Prepare U.S. Individual Income Tax Returns, including Form 1040.

Organize electronic tax workpapers and client files.

Enter tax information accurately into tax preparation software.

Prepare returns involving W-2 income, interest and dividends, retirement income, Schedule C, Schedule E, and basic investment transactions.

Schedule client appointments as needed.

Coordinate electronic signatures and filing authorizations.

Maintain clear, professional, and timely communication.



Administrative Support

Support the creation and improvement of tax procedures.

Assist with general administrative tasks related to the tax practice.

Help improve workflow efficiency and turnaround times.



Qualifications

At least 1–3 years of experience preparing or assisting with U.S. Individual Income Tax Returns.

Basic understanding of U.S. individual income tax preparation.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to manage multiple tax returns, projects, and deadlines.

Schedule C businesses

Client communication during tax season

title: Appointment Setter VA: Weekly Pay & Growth Opportunities
description:
Hi there!



We're searching for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Appointment Setter VA to join our remote team. 



This remote position offers an exciting opportunity for you to contribute to our client's success while enjoying the freedom and flexibility of a work-from-home lifestyle.



If you're passionate about helping others succeed and want to grow your career in a dynamic and supportive environment, then read on…







== WHY WORK WITH US ==



Make a Difference at Pro Sulum: An Award-Winning Company Where You Matter.



We're not just about accolades (like being on the Inc. 5000 list) - we're about empowering our team to create real impact. At Pro Sulum, your contributions matter, and your unique talents are valued. Join a company that fosters personal growth, celebrates individuality, and champions success for all.





-> Benefits:

 * Competitive salary (Php 30,000 to Php 40,000) depending on experience

 * Pay Increase Opportunity Every 6 Months

 * Weekly Pay

 * Paid Service Incentive Leaves

 * Monthly Incentives

 * Referral Incentives

 * Virtual Company Events

 * Dynamic, fun, and supportive team

 * Full-time role as an independent contractor (not BPO)

 * Long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement





== THE POSITION ==



As the Appointment Setter VA, you'll play a key role in generating qualified leads and scheduling appointments with homeowners across Central and Northern Illinois for roofing, siding, gutters, windows, and other exterior home improvement services.



Your primary responsibility will be making outbound calls, building rapport with homeowners, qualifying prospects, handling basic objections, following up with warm leads, and scheduling qualified appointments directly onto the sales team's calendar. You'll also maintain accurate lead records and coordinate closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handoff.



We're looking for a confident, personable, and resilient communicator with strong cold-calling and appointment-setting experience who can build rapport quickly, take ownership of results, and help lead a high-performing calling team.





-> Requirements:

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in phone sales, telemarketing, appointment setting, or lead generation.

• Experience in home improvement, roofing, construction, or a related industry is a strong advantage.

• Excellent, clear, and professional spoken English that is easily understood by US-based homeowners.

• Strong active listening and probing skills with the ability to identify customer needs and qualify prospects effectively.

• Ability to handle basic objections confidently and maintain a positive, professional attitude during calls.

• Strong multitasking skills — able to engage naturally with customers while taking accurate notes and gathering information for the sales team.

• Available to work full-time (40 hrs/week).

• Can work during standard US business hours.

• Fast, stable internet connection (minimum download speed of 10 Mbps).

• Working computer/laptop (minimum requirement: Intel i5 processor or equivalent, 8GB RAM).

• Backup power source or alternative work location during power outages.





-> Tools/Software:

• Experience working with the following tools is preferred: JobNimbus, MS Office Suite, SharePoint, VoIP





-> Responsibilities:

Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Make outbound cold calls to homeowners, promote the client’s services, qualify leads, handle basic objections, and schedule qualified appointments.

• Follow up with warm leads and past prospects to generate additional appointments.

• Manage and accurately schedule appointments in JobNimbus, coordinating with the sales team to avoid conflicts.

• Maintain accurate lead information, call notes, and outcomes in JobNimbus/SharePoint.

• Keep lead lists and customer records organized and free of duplicates.

• Review client-provided process videos and create/update SOPs as needed.

• Help lead, motivate, and monitor the calling team to achieve performance goals.

• Proactively identify scheduling, lead management, and process issues and take ownership of resolving them.





-> About You:

For this position, the successful candidate will have/be:

* High Attention to Detail: You are accurate, consistent, and thorough in your work. 

* Dependable & Trustworthy: You complete tasks on time and follow through on your commitments.

* Resourceful & Proactive: You tackle challenges head-on and solve problems independently.

* Great Communicator: You excel in both written and verbal English communication.





== HOW TO APPLY ==



Ready to join us? Apply now and unlock your future with Pro Sulum!



If you are interested in this position and believe you have the qualities listed above to be successful, please complete this Google Form and FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS carefully.



APPLY HERE >>>

 from the Pro Sulum Recruitment Team within 1-2 weeks.

title: BUSINESS CREDIT & FUNDING SPECIALIST
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Business Credit & Funding Specialist to join our growing credit and funding company.



This is NOT an entry-level position and NOT a trainable role.



We are looking for someone who already has hands-on experience with business credit building, business fundability, lender requirements, and business funding strategies and can confidently manage client profiles with minimal supervision.



Our ideal candidate understands how to take a business from:



Business Setup ? Business Credit Development ? Fundability ? Lender Readiness ? Funding



You should be able to review a client’s complete profile, identify what is preventing them from obtaining funding, create a strategic action plan, and determine when and when NOT to apply for funding.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Review client business profiles for overall fundability and lender readiness

Identify issues that may prevent or reduce funding approvals

Review business entity structure, LLC/corporate information, and compliance

Review EIN and other required business information

Help ensure businesses are properly established and positioned for funding

Assist clients with establishing appropriate business banking relationships

Build and develop business credit profiles from the ground up

Work with Dun & Bradstreet, Experian Business, Equifax Business, and other relevant business credit reporting systems

Establish and strategically manage Net-30/vendor accounts when appropriate

Build strong business payment history and business credit profiles

Monitor business credit reports and identify inaccurate or missing information

Understand how personal credit, business credit, revenue, time in business, banking activity, and other factors affect fundability

Evaluate clients for business credit cards, lines of credit, loans, and other legitimate business funding products

Research appropriate lenders and funding opportunities based on each client’s individual profile

Understand lender underwriting requirements and approval criteria

Create strategic funding sequences rather than submitting unnecessary applications

Help protect clients from unnecessary inquiries, premature applications, and avoidable denials

Prepare clients and their businesses before funding applications are submitted

Assist with appropriate business funding applications

Track funding applications, approvals, denials, credit limits, and client progress

Follow up on funding applications and determine appropriate next steps

Maintain organized and detailed client records

Communicate professionally with clients regarding their business credit and funding progress

Educate clients on maintaining strong business credit and lender readiness

Stay current on business credit strategies, lender requirements, underwriting changes, and funding opportunities



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are specifically looking for someone who already knows this industry.



You should be able to review a business profile and confidently determine:



Where the client currently stands

What is preventing the client from being fundable

What needs to be corrected

What needs to be established or strengthened

Whether personal credit is affecting funding opportunities

Which funding products may be appropriate

Which lenders may be appropriate

What order funding applications should occur in

When a client should NOT apply yet

What needs to happen next to improve the client’s chances of approval



We are looking for someone who understands strategy not simply submitting applications.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Applicants should have:



Proven experience building business credit profiles from start to finish

Proven experience helping businesses become funding-ready

Direct experience with business funding

Strong knowledge of business credit cards, lines of credit, loans, vendor credit, and other business funding products

Strong understanding of business fundability and lender requirements

Knowledge of LLC/corporate structures and business compliance

Experience with Dun & Bradstreet, Experian Business, Equifax Business, and business credit reporting

Experience establishing and managing Net-30/vendor accounts

Understanding of personal guarantees and the relationship between personal and business credit in funding decisions

Understanding of lender underwriting requirements

Ability to research lenders and funding products independently

Ability to create individualized funding strategies based on a client’s complete profile

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Ability to communicate professionally with clients

Ability to independently manage multiple client profiles

Strong documentation, organization, and follow-up skills

High attention to detail



EXPERIENCE MUST BE VERIFIABLE



Please do not apply if your primary experience is general virtual assistance and you have only limited exposure to business credit or funding.



We are interested in candidates who can demonstrate real-world experience.



Qualified applicants should be prepared to discuss:



Businesses they have helped become fundable

Business credit profiles they have developed

Funding strategies they have created

Types of lenders and funding products they have worked with

Examples of funding approvals or outcomes they have helped clients achieve

Their process for determining whether a client is funding-ready



References, case studies, previous work examples, or other verifiable experience are strongly preferred.



PAID SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Final candidates may be asked to complete a paid hypothetical client assessment before being hired.



You may receive a sample business/client profile and be asked:



What is preventing this client from being fundable?

What would you correct first?

What would your 30–90 day strategy be?

What funding products would you consider?

Which lenders or types of lenders would you consider?

What would you NOT apply for yet, and why?

What additional information would you need before making a funding recommendation?



We want to understand how you think and how you approach funding strategy.



SCHEDULE



Remote contract position.



Hours and workload will be discussed based on experience, availability, and current client volume.



Candidates should be dependable, responsive, and able to manage their responsibilities independently.



COMPENSATION



Competitive compensation based on demonstrated experience.



Compensation will be discussed during the interview process based on your level of business credit and funding expertise.



Performance-based incentives may also be available for defined client and funding milestones.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



Your resume or summary of relevant experience

How many years you have worked specifically with business credit and/or business funding

A brief description of your business funding experience

The types of funding products and lenders you have experience working with

Your experience with business credit bureaus and vendor accounts

One example of a business funding strategy you have successfully helped execute

Your current availability and approximate hours available per week

Your desired hourly or monthly compensation in USD

Any references, case studies, or examples of previous results you can provide



Please begin your application with the words “FUNDING SPECIALIST” so we know you read the entire posting.



We are building a strong business credit and funding division and are looking for someone who wants the opportunity to grow with us.



Our goal is not to submit as many applications as possible.



Our goal is to properly prepare each client, protect their credit profile, strengthen their business, identify appropriate funding opportunities, and create the strongest possible path toward sustainable business funding.



If you already know how to do this and can demonstrate your experience, we would like to hear from you.
