title: Short Form Video Editor + Graphic Designer
description:
KIKI Textiles is looking for a highly skilled Video Editor who also has Graphic Design skills to join our team full-time.



Please look at our brand, website, and Instagram before applying so you understand who we are, our products, and our current visual direction. 
 and 



We are building KIKI with the goal of becoming the biggest fashion textile brand in the United States, and we are currently going through a major brand and visual evolution.



This is not a basic editing position.



Our #1 priority is strong VIDEO/Reels EDITING skills.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to put clips together, add captions in CapCut, and add basic transitions. Most of our daily videos are relatively simple because authenticity is important to our brand, but when we need something elevated, artistic, complex, or highly polished, you need to have the skills to deliver it.



Graphic design is also an important part of this position, but video editing comes first. If your graphic design skills still have room to improve but your video editing skills, taste, creativity, and work ethic are exceptional, we are open to that.

 What You Will Create



You will work across different areas of KIKI's marketing, including:



* Short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, Pinterest, etc.

* Video ads for Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms

* Product videos

* Fabric and collection videos

* Promotional and sale videos

* Product launch videos

* Website videos and banners

*
 marketing graphics

* Meta and Google PPC graphics

* Social media graphics

* Product-focused marketing graphics

* Campaign creatives

* AI-generated and AI-enhanced visuals

* Motion graphics when needed

* Different hooks and variations of existing winning creatives

* Reusable templates

* Other creative assets needed by our marketing team



This is a flexible creative role. Some days you may edit many simple short-form videos. Other days you may work on a more complex ad, create graphics for an
 campaign, work with AI, develop a creative concept, or help us improve the visual direction of the brand.



We need someone creative, flexible, curious, and willing to learn.

 You Need to Have TASTE



This is extremely important to us.



Our customers are designers, sewists, creators, and fashion professionals. The product itself is visual and creative.



You need to understand what looks **expensive, fashionable, modern, feminine, elevated, artistic, and desirable.**



Technical editing skills without taste are not enough for this position.



We want someone who can look at raw footage of a fabric and immediately start thinking:



You need to understand that these are not simply pretty videos. The ultimate goal is to **generate sales**.



That means understanding:



* Customer psychology

* Hooks

* Attention

* Desire

* Visual storytelling

* Pacing

* Music



You don't need to know everything about fabrics when you start. But over time, we expect you to understand what makes different fabrics special, what customers care about, and how to communicate those benefits visually.



## AI



We actively use AI as part of our creative process.



You don't need to be an AI expert today.



However, you **must be willing to learn AI video generation, AI image generation, and new creative AI tools.**



The creative industry is changing quickly, and we want someone who is excited to develop their skills rather than resist new tools.



At the same time, AI does not replace actual editing skills. We still need someone who genuinely understands professional video editing and design.



## SPEED IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT TO US



Please read this part carefully before applying.



We are a fast-moving ecommerce company with a **high volume of creative work**.



We need someone with **speed of execution**.



This does NOT mean we expect impossible deadlines.

But we are **not a good fit for someone who works very slowly**.

A simple video should not take an entire day to edit.

A simple question should not sit unanswered for two days.

If something is unclear, ask.

If you have a problem, communicate.

If you can finish something quickly, finish it quickly.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A-PLAYERS. AND YES, IF YOU PROOVE YOU BRING VALUE, YOU WILL GROW BIG WITH US.

We are very friendly and easy to work with, but **we don't have patience for unnecessary slowness, disappearing, or poor communication.**



We need someone who works.



Someone who tries.



Someone who communicates.



Someone who wants to become better.



Someone who actually cares about bringing value to the company.



## Communication



Communication needs to be **easy and prompt**.



We don't expect you to sit in front of your computer waiting for our messages every second.



But during working hours, communication should flow naturally and quickly.



We want this person to become part of our team, not simply receive assignments and disappear. It happen way too many times.



Ask questions. Give ideas. Tell us when you think something could be better. Learn the brand.



## Growth Potential



This is a full-time position.



There is **very high growth potential** for the right person.



If you prove that you are talented, work hard, learn quickly, understand our vision, become faster as you learn our products, and consistently bring value to KIKI, **your compensation will grow.**



We are looking for someone long-term.



As the company grows, we want the people who genuinely contribute to that growth to grow with us.



## Who We Are Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



* Are a genuinely strong video editor

* Have strong graphic design abilities

* Have excellent visual taste

* Understand fashion and modern aesthetics

* Understand ecommerce and advertising

* Understand social media

* Can edit both simple high-volume content AND complex polished videos

* Understand visual storytelling

* Understand hooks and customer psychology

* Can make products feel desirable

* Know how to use pacing, music, typography, transitions, effects, color, and sound properly

* Are comfortable working with raw footage

* Can create ad creatives that are designed to convert

* Are interested in AI video and image generation

* Learn quickly

* Work quickly

* Communicate promptly

* Take feedback well

* Are organized

* Are reliable

* Are flexible

* Take initiative

* Want to improve your skills

* Want a long-term position with growth potential



You may use Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, Figma, AI tools, or anything else.



**We don't care which software you use. We care about the final result.**



# HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ



We receive **hundreds of applications**, so please do NOT send us your entire portfolio.



We don't need to see 100 videos.



We want to see your **BEST work**.



### 1. Send 3–5 of your BEST videos.



Choose the videos that best demonstrate your:



* Taste

* Creativity

* Artistic ability

* Editing skills

* Fashion sense

* Storytelling

* Ability to make a product or brand feel desirable



If you have worked with **fashion, beauty, luxury, ecommerce, lifestyle, or visually strong brands**, we especially want to see those examples.



Please don't send only basic talking-head videos with captions.



Show us something that makes us think:



**"This person has taste."**



### 2. Send 3–5 of your BEST graphic designs.



Again, don't send everything.



Show us the work that best represents your visual ability and creativity.



We would rather see **3 exceptional designs than 50 average ones.**



### 3. Tell us briefly how you work.



In your message, tell us:



* What makes you a strong video editor?

* How do you approach editing a product video that needs to generate sales?

* How do you balance speed with quality?

* What AI creative tools have you used or would you like to learn?



Please keep it relatively short. We care more about the quality of your work than a long application.



## Want to Stand Out? Ask Us for Raw Footage.



If you genuinely believe you are a strong fit and want to show us what you can do, **message us and ask for KIKI raw footage.**



We can send you several raw clips and a small assignment so you can show us how you would approach editing content for our actual brand.



Because we receive hundreds of applications, unfortunately, we cannot pay hundreds of applicants to complete test edits.



**The test is completely optional.**



You do NOT need to complete it to apply.



But if you are serious about the position and want to demonstrate what you can actually do with our product, ask us for the raw footage and assignment.



We will notice the people who take initiative.



---



We are not looking simply for another freelancer.



We are looking for someone who can become an important part of KIKI's creative team, learn our products, understand our customers, grow their skills, bring ideas, work fast, and help us build a much stronger brand.



If that sounds like you, we'd like to see your work.

title: Operations Manager DTC brand
description:
Coffydoor | Remote but EU/UK TIME ZONE  | Fractional or Full-time

Coffydoor is one of Sweden's highest-rated coffee brands, built around a simple philosophy: 100?tter Mornings, 0% Nonsense. By combining the Italians craftsmanship that has been passed through generations with the latest research and science on coffee and its health benefits we are set out on a mission to deliver better mornings all across Europe.



Over the past year we've built a strong subscription business in Sweden and recently expanded into the UK, where we're now growing rapidly. As we scale, we're looking for someone who wants to build the operational foundation that allows the business to grow without adding unnecessary complexity.

This isn't a traditional Operations Manager role.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys solving operational problems, building systems, and creating structure. Someone who naturally questions manual processes, enjoys improving workflows, and believes great operations should be almost invisible because everything simply works.

You'll work closely with the founder, our Customer Experience Lead, developers, warehouse partners and external finance and growth team to ensure our operations continue to scale alongside the business.

What you'll be responsible for

Your role is to build operational infrastructure that allows Coffydoor to scale efficiently.

That means staying ahead of inventory rather than reacting to stockouts, ensuring suppliers and warehouses stay aligned, improving visibility across the business, and continuously identifying opportunities where systems, automation and AI can replace manual work.

You'll become the primary operational owner across purchasing, inventory planning, fulfilment and logistics, while working closely with our Customer Experience Lead to ensure operational improvements translate into a better customer experience.

As the business grows, you'll also help drive continuous improvement across our operational systems, making sure our tools, processes and reporting evolve alongside the company.

Success in this role isn't measured by how busy you are, it's measured by how much smoother the business runs because of the systems you've built.

We're looking for someone who...

Has experience operating within a fast-growing DTC or e-commerce business.

Understands how inventory, purchasing, fulfilment and customer experience all connect.

Has a strong understanding of Shopify and the wider e-commerce ecosystem.

Thinks in systems rather than spreadsheets, and naturally looks for opportunities to automate repetitive work.

Is comfortable using AI to improve workflows, documentation, reporting and operational efficiency.

Enjoys solving problems, taking ownership and continuously improving how a business operates.

Understands operational profitability and how decisions around suppliers, logistics and fulfilment impact margins and cash flow.

Communicates clearly, builds strong relationships with external partners, and is comfortable working across different teams.

Experience with subscription businesses, inventory forecasting, ERP/WMS systems, Gorgias or similar customer support platforms, and managing external warehouses or 3PL partners is highly valued.



Why Coffydoor?

We're still early enough that your work will have a direct impact on how the business operates for years to come.

This isn't about maintaining existing processes, it's about building them.

You'll work closely with the founder as we continue expanding internationally, with significant ownership and freedom to shape how operations should look as the business scales.

For the right person, this role offers the opportunity to grow into a long-term operational leadership position as the company continues to expand.



Working arrangement

We're flexible on how this role starts.

For the right person, we're happy to begin on either a fractional or full-time basis, with a clear path towards a permanent leadership role as Coffydoor continues to grow.



How to apply

Send a message with a short example of a project you've owned end to end, something that shows how you actually think and operate, not just what your title was. Tell us what the problem was, what you built or changed, and what happened as a result. Include your availability and whether you're looking at this fractionally or full-time.

title: Tiktok Shop Manager
description:
About Us



Thrive Creators is a creator commerce agency. We run TikTok Shop and affiliate programs for creator-led brands in the US — homesteading, cooking, home and kitchen. Our clients sell cookbooks and kitchen products to audiences that already trust them, and our job is to turn that trust into repeatable revenue.



We're small, fast, and we don't do busywork. If something isn't moving GMV, we kill it.



The Role



You'll own the affiliate program for our flagship client account end to end, and eventually across multiple client shops. Finding creators, vetting them, reaching out, managing the sample queue, chasing creators who went quiet, and making sure the affiliates on our roster are actually posting and actually converting.



This is not a "send 200 templated DMs a day" job. Volume outreach is already handled. This role is judgment: deciding who's worth a sample, who's worth a bigger commission, and who's burning our budget.



Remote, full-time, based in the Philippines.



What You'll Do

Search TikTok Shop's Creator Center and affiliate marketplace for creators who fit our clients — home cooking, baking, sourdough, homesteading, family kitchen, rural lifestyle

Vet creator profiles before approving samples — GMV history, recent video performance, audience quality, comment sentiment, and whether their audience actually buys

Manage the full sample request queue: approve, reject, or message. Reject sample farmers on sight

Run outreach and follow-up for qualified creators, and re-activate affiliates who received product and never posted

Source and recruit creators for TikTok Live selling

Watch what's working on the shop and feed creators specific hooks, formats, and angles — not generic "post more" advice

Track affiliate performance weekly, flag top performers for higher commission tiers or Target Collaboration deals, and flag concentration risk when too much GMV sits with one creator

Keep everything logged in Notion so the account is legible to the rest of the team

What We're Looking For

Hands-on experience with TikTok Shop Seller Center and Creator Center — affiliate invitations, open vs. target collaborations, sample requests, creator messaging

Experience managing an affiliate roster for a real shop (not just outreach, actual roster management)

Strong eye for content — you should be able to watch three of a creator's videos and tell us whether they can move product

Experience sourcing or managing TikTok Live sellers is a strong plus

Excellent written English. You'll be messaging US creators daily and representing our clients' brands

Self-directed and organized — you'll run a daily queue without anyone chasing you

Comfortable with at least 4 hours of overlap with US business hours

Bonus: experience with Shopify affiliate tools (UpPromote or similar), or using Claude / AI tools for research and outreach

Compensation

Fixed monthly rate, paid in USD (discussed based on experience)

Performance bonus tied to affiliate GMV

Paid monthly, on time, every time

Hours



Full-time, with required overlap with US hours.



To Apply — Complete This Task First



Applications without these will not be reviewed. Paste your answers directly in your application. No cover letter.



Task 1: Diagnose These Affiliates



Three affiliates from a client shop selling cookbooks and kitchen products to a home-cooking audience. Tell us what you see and exactly what you'd do.



Affiliate 1: 



480,000 followers

Average video views: 38,000

Videos posted for us: 2

Total GMV generated for our shop: $9,100

Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $3,200

Status: Hasn't posted for us in 3 months



Affiliate 2: 



21,000 followers (growing fast)

Videos posted for us: 41 | Lives: 3

Total GMV for our shop: $14,800

Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $48,000

Content quality: high

Status: Requested a second sample 6 weeks ago. Received it. Never posted.



Affiliate 3: 



34,000 followers (growing fast)

Videos posted for us: 162

Total GMV for our shop: $6,900 (~$43 per video)

Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $79,000

Content quality: very high

Average video views: 810

Status: Posts constantly. Barely converts.



For each affiliate:



What's actually going on here? Your honest read.

What would you do next? Be specific — not "follow up," but what you'd actually do and why.

Write the exact message you'd send them right now.



Then one more question:



Across this shop, 61% of affiliate GMV comes from a single creator. What's the risk, and what would you do about it over the next 90 days? (Note: AI Generated Answers are very easy to tell, we are looking for very specific things that illustrate your creative thinking)

You’ll be communicating on behalf of Sam (a local Australian), the face of the business, so excellent Australian written English, judgement and the ability to have natural conversations are extremely important.



YOU DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE:



- Responding quickly to new inbound leads

- Starting conversations with warm prospects and new followers

- Understanding each prospect’s goals, problems and situation

- Building genuine rapport through DMs

- Qualifying prospects to determine whether our coaching is suitable

- Moving qualified prospects towards booking a sales call

- Booking appointments into our calendar

- Following up people who stop replying

- Nurturing interested prospects who aren’t ready to book immediately

- Re-engaging older leads and stalled opportunities

- Following up prospects who were offered an appointment but never booked

- Following up no-shows where appropriate

- Managing leads and opportunities inside GoHighLevel

- Keeping notes, pipeline stages and next actions accurate

- Making sure genuine opportunities don’t get forgotten

- Working closely with our marketing and sales team to improve appointment quality and conversions



You will NOT be responsible for closing the high-ticket sale.



Your job is to nurture, qualify and book the right prospects so our sales team can take over from there.



Follow-up is a major part of this role



Not every good prospect books on day one.



Some disappear halfway through a conversation.



Some are interested but aren’t ready yet.



Some are offered an appointment and never choose a time.



Some book and don’t show.



Others may have spoken with us weeks ago and still be genuine opportunities.



We believe there is significant revenue sitting inside better nurture and follow-up, so we want somebody who already understands how to manage these opportunities properly.



You should have your own process for knowing:



- who needs following up

- when they should be contacted again

- how to keep a conversation moving

- how to nurture someone over time

- when to re-engage an older opportunity

- how to prevent leads from getting forgotten inside a CRM



We’ll teach you our offer, our customers and our messaging that already works at booking appointments.



We’re not looking to teach someone the fundamentals of appointment setting and lead follow-up from scratch.



This is not an entry-level VA position.



We’re looking for somebody with moderate previous experience in DM setting or appointment setting.



YOU SHOULD:



- Have previous DM or appointment setting experience

- Have experience using GoHighLevel

- Understand CRM and pipeline management

- Have excellent written English

- Be comfortable communicating with Australian prospects

- Communicate naturally rather than relying entirely on scripts

- Ask good questions and actually listen to what the prospect is saying

- Understand how to move a sales conversation forward

- Have a good understanding of lead nurture and follow-up

- Be persistent without being pushy

- Be highly organised

- Take ownership of your pipeline

- Be comfortable working towards KPIs

- Be reliable during agreed working hours

- Be coachable and open to feedback



Previous experience in fitness, health, coaching or another high-ticket online service business is a strong advantage.



Our prospects are generally mature men (40-60) years old with careers, businesses and families.



They don’t want to feel like they’re speaking with an aggressive salesperson.



We want somebody who can have a normal human conversation, while still understanding that this is a sales position and results matter.



WORKING HOURS:



This is a full-time, long-term employee position working 5.5 days per week.



All working hours are based on Melbourne, Australia time:



Monday to Thursday: 2:00pm–10:00pm

Friday: Off

Saturday: 11:00am–7:00pm

Sunday: 2:00pm–6:00pm



During these paid working hours you will be expected to work exclusively for our business.



You cannot perform work for another employer, client or freelance project during your scheduled hours.



We also use work activity / screen monitoring software during paid working hours.



If you are uncomfortable with either condition, this position will not be suitable for you.



BASE SALARY + COMMISSION



Base salary: ?30,000 PHP per month



PLUS:



?250 PHP for every sale closed from an appointment you booked.



We currently expect approximately 5–10 closed sales per week, depending on lead volume and performance.



There is room for greater responsibility and earning potential as the online coaching business grows.



This role probably isn’t for you if:

- You only like working fresh leads.

- You send one or two messages and then forget about someone.

- You need a manager telling you every day who needs following up.

- You don’t like keeping a CRM organised.

- You think follow-up means repeatedly sending “Hey, just checking in.”

- You immediately try to book everybody without properly understanding their situation.

- Or you rely completely on copy-and-paste scripts.



We want someone who takes ownership of the opportunity and the pipeline.



HOW TO APPLY:



We have created a detailed application form because we want to understand your real experience, follow-up process, GoHighLevel knowledge and approach to the role.



Please answer the application questions yourself.



Do not use ChatGPT or other AI tools to generate generic answers. AI-generated or obviously copied applications will be screened out.



If this sounds like the right role for you, complete the application here:



APPLY HERE: 



Applications submitted only through OnlineJobs.ph without completing the form will not be considered.

title: Tax Preparer
description:
About the Role 

FRAXN is looking for an experienced Tax Preparer with a strong focus on business tax returns to join our team. - Analyze financial statements, general ledgers, and supporting documentation to ensure accurate reporting

- Research and apply current tax law changes affecting business filings

- 3+ years of experience preparing business tax returns (partnerships, S-corps, C-corps) 

- CPA, EA (Enrolled Agent), or equivalent credential preferred (or actively pursuing) 

- Proficiency with professional tax preparation software (e.g., Drake, UltraTax, Lacerte, or similar) 

- Strong understanding of GAAP and business financial statements 

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills 

- Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, especially during tax season 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills 

- Experience with 1099 filing 



Additional Information

Must be willing to work Texas business hours (Central Time).

Will work directly under Fraxn's Tax Director, providing support on tax-related operations and engagements.

title: Finance Manager
description:
XERO BOOKKEEPER / FINANCE MANAGER — AUSTRALIAN BUSINESS

Part-time, 15 hours per week, permanent and long-term



ABOUT US



We are Divine Commercial Cleaning, a family-owned commercial cleaning

company based in Queensland, Australia. We have been operating since

2017 and we clean for medical centres, dental practices, offices,

childcare centres, gyms and shopping centres.



We are growing into new cities over the next few years, and we are

looking for one person to run the whole finance side of the business

as we do it. This is not a role we plan to change or replace. We want

someone who will still be with us in five years.



THE ROLE



You will be our only finance person. Everything that touches money

runs through you:



- Reconciling our bank account in Xero every working day

- Setting up and managing repeating invoices for our cleaning contracts

- Checking our cleaners' invoices against the hours in our scheduling

  system (Zoho), and entering them as bills in Xero

- Managing our accounts
 inbox and answering client questions

  about invoices and payments

- Following up overdue invoices every Monday

- Running weekly payroll and superannuation in Xero

- Preparing and lodging BAS (quarterly), QLeave returns (quarterly)

  and TPAR (annually)

- Creating new client and cleaner contacts in Xero

- Sending our Director a written report every Friday



You will NOT be handling any bank passwords or moving money. You

prepare payments, our Director releases them. That protects both of us.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Required:

- Real hands-on Xero experience. Bank reconciliation, invoicing,

  repeating invoices, bills, payroll. Please do not apply if you have

  only watched Xero tutorials — we will find out in week one.

- Understanding of Australian bookkeeping: BAS, GST, PAYG, Single

  Touch Payroll and superannuation. If you have not done all of these,

  tell us which ones you have done and which you have not. Honesty

  here is fine. Guessing is not.

- Very good written English. You will be
ing Australian business

  owners directly about their invoices.

- Accuracy with repetitive work. This job is mostly the same tasks in

  the same order every week. We need someone who does the ninetieth

  reconciliation as carefully as the first.

- Able to work independently. Nobody will be watching your screen.

- Reliable internet, your own computer, and a quiet place to work.

- Experience working with an Australian business before





Nice to have:

- Experience with Zoho CRM

- Experience with contractor payments and TPAR



THE ARRANGEMENT



- 15 hours per week, spread across five days (Monday to Friday).

  Roughly 3 hours a day, not two long days. Our bank reconciliation

  and our
 inbox both need attention daily.

- You must be available for at least 2 hours each day during

  Queensland business hours (AEST). Queensland is 2 hours ahead of

  Philippine time all year, so this is an easy overlap — for example,

  8am to 11am Philippine time is 10am to 1pm here.

- Paid weekly via Wise, against a simple invoice of your hours.

- Permanent and long-term. We are not looking for short-term or

  project help.

- Full written procedure manual and training videos provided. You

  will not have to guess how we do things.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a generic application. We read every one properly

and we can tell.



Start your message with the word RECONCILE so we know you read the

whole ad.



Then answer these four questions:



1. How long have you used Xero, and what did you use it for? Be

   specific about the tasks, not just the number of years.

2. Which of these have you done yourself: BAS, GST coding, PAYG,

   Single Touch Payroll, superannuation, TPAR? For each one, say yes

   or no.

3. In Xero, a $500 payment comes into the bank account from a client

   who has three unpaid invoices — $200, $500 and $300, from oldest

   to newest. Which invoice do you allocate the payment to, and why?

4. What hours would you work each day, in Philippine time?



Also tell us your rate, and attach or link your CV.



We will reply to every applicant who follows these steps.

title: Finance & Operations Analyst (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
We are looking for a detail-driven Finance & Operations Analyst to take ownership of financial reporting, analysis, and operational finance oversight for a growing Australian ecommerce business.



This is a full-time, long-term role.



Right now, much of this reporting, oversight, and analysis sits with the founder. This role exists to take that responsibility over and turn it into a structured, reliable process. You will produce monthly performance reporting, analyse product-level profitability, track refunds and disputes, oversee outgoing payments and customer withdrawals, calculate commission and bonus payments, and support treasury across multi-currency accounts.



This is not a day-to-day bookkeeping or tax compliance role. We already have an accounts team and external accountants handling those functions. Your role sits above the transaction-processing layer: analysing results, verifying financial activity, investigating discrepancies, and giving management a clear view of how the business is actually performing.



You should be comfortable investigating why a number moved, not just reporting that it did.



Responsibilities:



Monthly Reporting & Analysis

- Own the monthly management reporting pack, bringing together product performance, margins, marketing spend, refunds, disputes, payment costs, commissions, cash positions, and other key financial metrics into one clear report for management

- Prepare monthly product-level performance reports covering revenue, cost of goods, marketing spend (Google Ads, Meta Ads), refunds, relevant transaction costs, and contribution margin

- Track and report refund volumes, refund rates, dispute counts, dispute win rates, and month-on-month trends

Investigate and explain notable movements. Don’t just report the “what,” explain the “why”

- Build and maintain repeatable spreadsheets, dashboards, and trackers so recurring reports can be produced accurately and consistently each month



Financial Oversight & Controls

- Review outgoing payments and customer withdrawals processed by the accounts team, checking that amounts are correct, properly documented, and consistent with internal systems and approvals

- Maintain regular oversight of withdrawal activity and flag unusual patterns, discrepancies, duplicate payments, missing records, or process issues

- Review the monthly P&L in Xero, investigate material changes or unusual expense movements, and raise anything requiring management attention

- Monitor payment processing costs, dispute fees, FX costs, and other transaction-related expenses, highlighting material changes or opportunities to reduce costs



Commission & Bonus Administration

- Maintain agreed commission and bonus structures across relevant teams and calculate monthly entitlements according to the applicable rules

- This may include product-based commissions, influencer performance incentives, dispute-win bonuses, and other performance-based compensation

- Prepare accurate payment schedules with supporting calculations and coordinate with the accounts team for payout

Investigate and resolve calculation discrepancies and maintain clear records showing how each payment was determined

- You calculate and verify; the accounts team executes the payments



Treasury Support

- Monitor foreign currency balances, including GBP, EUR, CAD, USD, and AUD, across company accounts

- Identify excess foreign currency balances requiring conversion and coordinate conversions or withdrawals in accordance with company guidelines

- Maintain visibility over cash positions across major accounts and flag unusual balances, movements, or upcoming liquidity requirements

- Assist with maintaining an efficient process for managing foreign currency balances as the business grows



Process & Documentation

- Document workflows and processes as you learn them, building a clear finance operations playbook

- Maintain organised records supporting recurring reports, commission calculations, financial checks, and other responsibilities

- Identify repetitive or inefficient processes that could be improved, standardised, or automated



Role Scope

This role does not involve lodging tax filings or day-to-day bookkeeping. The accounts team executes payments and handles transaction processing, while our external accountants handle tax and compliance.



Your responsibility is analysis, verification, reporting, financial oversight, and raising issues to management.



You will not be expected to operate as a CFO, Financial Controller, or senior accountant. This is a hands-on analyst role focused on giving management accurate financial visibility and ensuring recurring finance processes are being completed correctly.



Required Experience

- 2+ years in a financial analyst, reporting, FP&A, finance operations, or similar analytical finance role

- Accounting or bookkeeping experience is valuable, but you must be able to demonstrate analysis and reporting work, not only transaction processing

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills, including building clean, repeatable reports and trackers from raw data

- Working knowledge of Xero or a similar accounting platform, enough to read a P&L and investigate individual expense lines

- Strong attention to detail. You catch the small discrepancy nobody else noticed

- Able to investigate unclear numbers rather than accepting them at face value

- Comfortable working independently with recurring monthly responsibilities and deadlines

- Reliable, organised, and comfortable raising issues proactively

- Strong written English communication. Your reports need to be clear and easy to act on



Strongly Preferred

- Experience with ecommerce businesses, including refunds, chargebacks/disputes, and payment processors

- Experience with multi-currency accounts and FX conversions

- Experience calculating commissions, bonuses, or other incentive payments

- Experience building recurring management reports, dashboards, or financial trackers

- Experience working with Australian businesses

- Formal qualifications in Finance, Accounting, or a related field



Confidentiality and Access

- You will handle sensitive financial and business information

- You will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and follow strict credential-handling procedures

- Access will be limited to the systems and permissions required to perform the role



Hours and Benefits

- Monday to Friday schedule

- Paid vacation leave after three months

- Stable, long-term role with a growing Australian company

- A newly created position with real ownership and the opportunity to build reliable reporting and finance processes as the business grows



Application Questions

1. Describe your experience in financial analysis or reporting, including the kinds of reports you built and who they were for.

2. Describe a time you identified a financial error, discrepancy, or unusual transaction that others had missed. What did you do about it?

3. You are reviewing a month where the contribution margin on one product dropped noticeably. Walk us through, step by step, how you would investigate the cause.

4. You receive sales or revenue data from multiple systems and the monthly totals do not match. How would you determine which figure is correct and identify the cause of the difference?

5. A staff member disagrees with the commission amount you calculated for them. How would you verify your figure and resolve the disagreement?

6. What is your experience level with Xero and Excel/Google Sheets? Please give specific examples of what you have built or done in each.

7. Please include a link to your LinkedIn profile if you have one.

Please begin your application with MC so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Ecom Brand Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a video editor who has worked with direct-response brands doing $1M-$10M+ in revenue and can prove it.



Not someone who can cut clips. Someone who understands viewer psychology — what makes them stop, what makes them stay, and what makes them watch all the way to the end.



You'll receive detailed creative briefs from our strategist. Your job is to turn them into ads that feel native, real, and impossible to scroll past. Not overproduced. Not stuffed with effects.



What we actually care about:

- Pacing that matches the script and the angle — not generic "fast cuts"

- Visual selection that reinforces the message in every frame

- Edits that feel like content, not like ads

- Knowing when to show the avatar, when to cut to b-roll, and when to let a frame breathe



What we don't care about:

- Flashy transitions

- Motion graphics for the sake of motion graphics

- A reel full of brand videos that look pretty but never ran as paid ads



Requirements:

- You've edited video ads for brands doing at least mid 6 to 7 figures. Not spec work. Real ads that spent real money.

- You know how to work with AI tools — generating AI avatars, AI voiceovers, cartoon/animated visuals, and b-roll. 

- Attach your portfolio — no portfolio, no response. Show us ads you edited that actually ran. If you can share performance data (hook rate, spend, ROAS), even better.



How this works:

Step 1 — Send your portfolio.

Step 2 — If we like your work, we'll reach out with a trial batch and a real brief to evaluate pacing, creative interpretation, style, and attention retention.

Step 3 — Ongoing work. Formats include viral-style ads, AI voiceover + b-roll, AI UGC avatar ads, VSLs, and other direct response formats.

ntum" so we know you actually read this.

title: Architectural Designer / 3D Visualiser – Façade & Cladding Design
description:
We are an Australian construction and building materials company looking for an experienced Architectural Designer / Draftsperson & 3D Visualiser to assist with a warehouse/showroom design project in Perth, Australia.



This will be a paid trial project, with the opportunity for ongoing work if the quality is good.



PROJECT 1 – INTERNAL CLADDING FEATURE WALL



We have a large internal warehouse/showroom wall that will be used to display different architectural cladding products to builders, architects, designers and customers.



The designer will need to:



Review our existing architectural floor plans, elevations and sections.

Design the overall cladding wall layout.

Incorporate 3 different cladding installation styles, including horizontal lap cladding, horizontal panel cladding and vertical cladding.

Develop a modern, premium and architectural appearance.

Select suitable combinations from the colours and finishes we provide.

Design transitions, trims, panel joints and feature sections.

Prepare 2–3 initial design concepts.

Produce high-quality photorealistic 3D renders.

After approval, prepare a clear 2D elevation / layout drawing with dimensions, material references and installation directions.



PROJECT 2 – MAIN ENTRANCE / FAÇADE DESIGN



We also require a new architectural design for the main warehouse/showroom entrance.



The entrance should look modern, premium and impressive and create a strong first impression for customers, builders and architects visiting the showroom.



The designer will need to:



Develop a new entrance/façade concept around the existing main entry.

Incorporate architectural cladding and feature materials.

Consider signage/logo location, feature lighting and entrance detailing.

Coordinate the entrance design with the internal showroom/cladding wall design.

Provide 2–3 design concepts.

Produce realistic daytime and/or evening 3D renders.

Prepare elevation drawings for the selected design.



WE WILL PROVIDE



Existing architectural drawings

Site photos and dimensions

Cladding product information

Installation examples

Colour and material samples

Reference images showing the style we are looking for



REQUIRED SKILLS



AutoCAD and/or Revit

SketchUp, 3ds Max or similar

Enscape, Lumion, V-Ray or equivalent

Architectural façade and exterior design

Cladding / building material knowledge preferred

Ability to read construction drawings

Ability to produce both technical drawings and high-quality 3D renders



IMPORTANT



We are not looking for someone who only produces interior decoration renders.



You must be able to understand architectural/construction drawings and turn the design into practical elevations and layouts that can later be used for construction.



TO APPLY, PLEASE SEND:



Examples of façade/exterior designs you have completed

Examples of architectural 3D renders

Examples of construction/elevation drawings

Software you use

Your estimated time to complete this trial project

Your proposed price



If the trial project is successful, we have ongoing Australian construction, shop drawing, façade, cladding and 3D visualisation work available.

title: Business Development Manager South East ASIA

, word processing, and spreadsheet applications.

title: Sales Assistant
description:
Level Up is looking for someone who will execute the engine behind Lux & Nyx corporate gifting channel — the B2B line we sell through promotional-products distributors (Staples Promotional, HALO, Promoshop, and peers) who place our bags into corporate, executive-incentive, and employee-appreciation programs. Our founder sets the strategy and closes the deals. You do everything around that: build and run the outbound (one master contact list, trade-show campaigns,
 copy, CRM), respond to and nurture distributors into warm opportunities, and keep orders moving cleanly through our decorator and warehouse.



Key Responsibilities:

The outbound engine — the trade-show prospecting campaigns (like ASI Chicago), ONE master filterable contact list, the outreach copy, and subject-line A/B testing.

The CRM flywheel — turn cold contacts into warm relationships and keep them warm; nurture distributors (Staples, HALO, Promoshop) so nothing lapses; hand the founder warm, ready-to-close opportunities.

Consultative response — read a distributor’s client brief and recommend the right products, MOQs, and decoration (embroidery, DTF, deboss) that fit the vibe, quantity, and price; prep the quote for the founder to close.

Order ops — read POs, catch a price/MOQ error, track in-hand dates (IHD), and run orders clean through the decorator (deco shop) and kitting/warehouse. Catch the wrong-address before it ships.

The cadence — run the campaign calendar, tell the founder what you need and when, and pull the copy/decisions from them on schedule. You drive; we don’t chase you.



Qualifications:

You drive — you don't wait. You run the calendar and pull what you need from us on schedule. This is the #1 thing we're screening for.

3+ years in B2B sales ops, outbound/demand-gen, or e-commerce coordination — ideally with distributor, reseller, or promotional-products (ASI/PPAI) exposure.

Hands-on with outbound: you've built and run a real contact list and
 campaigns (Apollo / a CRM / an
 tool), and you understand ONE master filterable list beats scattered ones.

A clear B2B writer who tests — you can take a direction and turn it into outreach that gets opened, and you A/B-test subject lines rather than guess.

A reliable operator — high-volume orders and coordination without dropping balls; you catch the error before it ships.

Comfortable in async, remote, founder-led environments, with meaningful overlap with US business hours (distributors are US-based).

AI-native — you've built workflows where AI carries the volume so you supervise, not grind.

Nice to have: promo-industry experience, and comfort building simple automations (Make/Zapier) — a plus, not required.



What separates great from good:

Runs the cadence and manages up — tells the founder what's needed and by when; the founder never has to trigger the work or chase them.

Owns the numbers they control — knows their pipeline, open rates, and warm-opp count cold.

Leads before it's asked — spots the gap and acts, instead of waiting for a task.

Makes the distributor's (and the founder's) job effortless — fast, clean, quote-ready.

Comfortable with ambiguity — turns a rough direction into a shipped campaign.



How we work together:

Weekly team sync — priorities, pipeline, and what's shipping.

Regular 1:1s with the founder.

Quarterly planning — themes, major gifting 
nts (holiday, events), and KPI targets.

Async-first via Slack — decisions documented, same-day response on blockers.



How to apply:

Start your application with the word GIFTING, and in three sentences tell us about a time you caught a problem before it blew up — something no one asked you to look for. Applications that skip this won't be read.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Us

We are an Australian digital marketing agency working exclusively with healthcare practices. We have worked with more than 250 practices across Australia.



Our team is small, remote and mostly Philippines-based. We move fast, we use AI properly rather than as a novelty, and we care about output quality more than hours logged.



The Role

You will join our SEO and content team, reporting to our Head of Strategy. Your job is to turn content strategy into published pages: writing and editing, building pages in WordPress, and rolling out local service pages across client sites at volume.



This is a production role with real craft in it. You need to write well, work quickly in WordPress, and use AI tools to multiply your output without letting quality slip.



What You Will Do

- Write, edit and publish blog articles for dental and medical practice websites

- Build and roll out local service pages by duplicating existing page templates and adapting the content, headings, internal links and metadata for each new location or service

- Use Claude to draft, expand and refine content, then edit it into something that reads naturally and matches each client's voice

- Format posts and pages in WordPress including headings, images, alt text, internal links, meta titles and descriptions

- Apply on-page SEO basics: keyword placement, heading structure, schema where required, clean URLs

- Maintain content calendars and keep tasks updated in our project management system

- Quality-check your own work before it goes live. Broken links, wrong practice names and leftover placeholder text are the things we care most about catching

- Support the wider SEO team with research, briefs, competitor checks and reporting inputs



What You Need

- 2+ years in a digital marketing or SEO content role

- Strong written English. You will be writing for an Australian audience, so your copy needs to read like a native speaker wrote it

- Hands-on WordPress experience. You should be comfortable duplicating pages, working with page builders, managing media and editing SEO plugin fields without needing hand-holding

- Working experience with Claude or similar AI tools. Not just "I have used ChatGPT" but a real sense of how to prompt, iterate and edit output into something publishable

- Solid understanding of on-page SEO fundamentals

- High attention to detail. Repetitive page rollouts are easy to get sloppy with and we need someone who does not

- Reliable internet and a quiet work setup

- Able to work independently, report progress clearly and ask questions early rather than guessing



Nice To Have

- Experience writing for healthcare, medical or dental clients

- Familiarity with Australian advertising rules for healthcare (AHPRA guidelines). We will train you on this, but knowing it already is a plus

- Ahrefs, Google Search Console or Google Analytics experience

- Experience with Teamwork, GoHighLevel, or similar tools

- Basic HTML or CSS for fixing formatting issues



Why You Might Like Working Here

- Long-term, stable role on a team that is growing

- You will be given proper AI tooling and expected to use it, not restricted to manual grunt work

- Direct access to the strategy lead and the agency owner. No layers of middle management

- Clear processes and documented workflows, not chaos

title: Social Media Sales Appointment Setter (Full-Time) | Base + Commission | US Fitness Coaching Brand
description:
**Job Type:** Full-Time (40 hrs/week)



**Salary:** Monthly base retainer + performance commission on closed sales (details discussed at interview)



**ABOUT US**



We are a US-based online fitness coaching business. Our founder is a national-level physique competitor and former aerospace engineer, and we help clients transform their health through 16-week coaching programs. We have 95,000+ engaged followers across TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube. Your job is to turn that audience into booked sales calls.



**THE ROLE**



You will be the first human touchpoint for people interested in our coaching. You start genuine conversations in the DMs, build rapport over time, and book warm, qualified leads directly into our founder's Calendly.



This is a relationship-first role. We do NOT want spammy copy-paste blasting. We provide proven templates; you personalize every message and let conversations develop naturally. Rapport first, appointment second.



**WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY**



- Send 200 to 300 outbound DMs per day across our platforms (TikTok is the top priority, then Instagram, then
, then YouTube)

- Personalize our message templates for each person based on their profile and engagement

- Nurture replies at a natural pace and move warm leads toward a sales call

- Book interested leads directly into Calendly

- Write a short summary of every conversation that leads to a booked call

- Log your daily numbers (DMs sent, replies, conversations, calls booked)



**COMPENSATION**



- A guaranteed monthly base retainer, paid regardless of performance, so you always have a stable floor

- Plus performance commission on every booked call that turns into a closed sale. Commission scales with the program tier the client purchases: closing our premium program pays roughly triple what our entry program pays, so nurturing quality leads directly increases your income

- You receive a conversion report every week, so you always know exactly which of your bookings closed and what you've earned

- Total earnings for a consistent performer land well above typical full-time setter rates, with no hard ceiling on the commission side

- Exact figures are shared at the interview stage



Note: commission is paid on CLOSED sales, not just booked calls. This role rewards setters who book genuinely interested people, not calendar-stuffers.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word MACKEREL as the very first word and the subject of the message. Applications that do not start with MACKEREL will be deleted without being read. This is how we filter for people who pay attention to detail, which is the #1 skill in this role.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent written English with a natural, conversational American tone

- Must be available to work US hours: approximately 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Mountain Time, Monday to Friday. This is a firm requirement; our audience is most active during US afternoons and evenings, and fast reply speed during those hours is core to this role.

- Experience as an appointment setter, DM setter, or chat-based sales role (fitness, coaching, or online business niche is a big plus)

- Comfortable with high daily volume without losing warmth or quality

- Full-time availability, reliable internet, strong self-management

- Familiar with TikTok, Instagram, and
 
 interfaces

- Calendly experience is a plus



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**



- Not a hard-sell or pressure role. If you burn leads by rushing them, this is not the right fit.

- Not a content creation or design role.

- You do not close sales on calls. You book them; our founder closes them.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Your application must include ALL of the following, in this order:



1. The word MACKEREL as the very first word of your application

2. A short intro: your setter/DM experience and the niches you have worked in

3. Your response to this scenario, written exactly as you would send it: A woman comments "I needed to hear this" on one of our videos about why undereating stalls fat loss. Write your opening DM to her.

4. Your earliest start date and confirmation that you can work full-time on the stated US hours schedule



Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered.



---



One honest heads-up: on OnlineJobs.ph, listings without any salary figure get noticeably fewer applicants, since experienced setters filter by pay. The "well above typical setter rates" and "premium pays triple entry" lines are there to compensate for that, but if application volume comes in thin after a week, adding just a total earnings range (without revealing the base/commission split) is the usual fix.

title: Operations Manager — Coaching Program (AI & Automation) | Long-Term, Full-Time
description:
Read this part first

If you're looking for a job where someone tells you what to do each morning, this isn't it. We already have people who can hand out tasks. What we don't have is someone who looks at how we run, sees what's broken, and fixes it before anyone asks.



If that sounds like you, keep reading. If it doesn't, no hard feelings — save yourself the application.



Who we are

We're Digital Kairos. We run Brick by Brick, a cohort-based coaching program that helps consultants, coaches, and business owners build their brand and get clients on LinkedIn. Members join in classes of about 30, do daily homework, hit milestones, get on teaching calls, and lay bricks — literally, we mail them one.



We're a small remote team, mostly US-based, and we move fast. Our members pay real money and they get real results, and the reason that works is that the operations behind them are tight. Right now those operations run on people remembering things. We want them to run on systems.



That's your job.

-------------------



What you'll actually do:

Run the machine. Every cohort has a rhythm: applications come in, people get approved, they pay, they get onboarded, they get channels and access, they do homework, they hit milestones, they unlock calls, they graduate, some move up to our next-level program. You own all of it, start to finish, for every member. Nothing slips through.



Build the machine. This is the part that matters most. Right now too much of the above happens by hand — 30 individual messages sent one at a time, progress counted manually across 30 channels, recordings uploaded one by one. You'll use Claude, Zapier, and whatever else works to automate it, so the next class costs us less time than the last one. We already have a list of things waiting to be built. You'll add to it.



Organize us. Our team lives in Slack and we're mid-migration into Notion. Things live in three places and belong in one. You'll bring structure — clean systems, written processes, one source of truth — and hold us to it.



Take care of our members. You'll message our members more than anyone else on our team does. When someone falls behind, you notice. When someone's confused, you fix it before it becomes a complaint. When someone wins, you catch it and make sure it gets celebrated. This part isn't admin work — it's the experience people paid for.



Tell us what's happening. Over-communicate. Every week we want to know what shipped, what's at risk, what you noticed, and what you're changing. If you go quiet, we assume something's wrong.



-------------------



Your first 90 days

So you know this is a real job with real work waiting, here's some of what's actually sitting on the list:



- Write the cohort rulebook — every deadline, threshold, and unlock in one document, so nobody has to ask again

- Automate our application and onboarding flow (it's been on our list since June)

- Fix a broken Zapier automation between our contract and invoicing tools

- Automate our milestone messages, which are currently sent by hand, one member at a time

- Build a dashboard that shows who's behind, replacing manual counting

- Write our offboarding process, which currently exists only in people's heads



-------------------



What you need to have

- 2+ years running operations for a cohort program, membership, mastermind, online course, or coaching business. You've done this specific kind of work, not adjacent work.

- Slack at an admin level — channels, user groups, workflows, permissions

- Notion as a builder — you make databases and views, you don't just fill them in

- Zapier or Make — you've built multi-step automations with conditional logic, and you've debugged one that broke at a bad time

- AI as a daily tool. We run on Claude. You should already be using AI to do your actual work, not experimenting with it on the side. If you've set up projects, custom instructions, or recurring automated tasks, say so.

- Skool, Zoom, Calendly, Google Workspace — or the confidence to be fluent in a week

- Excellent written English. You'll write messages that go directly to our paying members. We need to trust you to hit send.

- Availability that overlaps US business hours — roughly 9AM–5PM US Central, which is about 10PM–6AM Philippine time. Being straight with you: this is a night shift. Please only apply if that genuinely works for your life.





-------------------



Nice to have

- Dashboard building, other no-code tools, experience writing SOPs for a team that had none, experience running two cohorts at once.



Pay and growth

- $1,200 USD/month, full-time

- 90-day review with a clear path to $1,500/month — tied to documenting the cohort playbook and shipping two working automations, not to a calendar date

- Quarterly performance bonus tied to member completion rates and automations shipped

- 13th month pay

- Paid time off and Philippine holidays

- This is a long-term role with room above it. As we grow, this seat grows — more programs, more systems, and eventually people to lead. We're hiring someone to build a career here, not to fill a gap.



-------------------



What working with us is like

We're direct and we move fast. We'd rather you try something and get it wrong than wait for permission. If you're stuck for more than an hour, ask — but come with what you already tried.



We don't micromanage, and we don't want to. The tradeoff is that we need you to be the kind of person who doesn't need it. For the first 30 days a teammate will review your member-facing messages while you learn our voice. After that, you send them yourself.



----------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

Read this carefully. We're using it to filter, and most applications will not make it past this section.



1. Subject line. Use exactly this, filling in the blank with your favorite automation tool:

Brick by Brick Ops — [your favorite automation tool]



2. In your message, answer these two questions. Keep it short — a few sentences each. We care about specifics, not polish.



Q1. Tell us about one workflow you automated. What tool did you use, what broke, and what did you do about it?

Q2. Here's a real situation. You have 30 members. Nine of them are behind on homework. There's a teaching call in four hours, and the rule for this week's homework requirement isn't written down anywhere. What do you do in your first hour — and what would you build so this never happens again?



3. Record a 2-minute Loom and paste the link. We watch all of them, and we can tell when it's the same video sent to fifty companies. Answer these three, in order:



(0:00–0:30) Who are you and what do you do now?

(0:30–1:15) Show us how you actually use AI in your work. Don't describe it — share your screen and walk us through something real you built or use.

(1:15–2:00) What made you apply to this job specifically? And tell us one thing you'd change about how we've described the role, or something you noticed we might be getting wrong.



Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed. Applications with a generic Loom won't either.



-------------------

title: Technical SEO Specialist
description:
What is LegalBuzz



LegalBuzz is a platform that's changing how law firms get found, trusted, and chosen in the age of AI.



When people need a lawyer today, they're not just searching Google; they're asking ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI-powered search engines to recommend one. Most law firms have no idea this is happening, let alone how to show up in those results. That's the problem LegalBuzz solves.



We combine proven SEO with AI search optimisation to make sure our clients (law firms across the UK, Australia, the USA, and Canada, including Legal 500 firms) get found wherever their clients are looking, and turn that visibility into real enquiries.



The Role



We're looking for a Technical SEO Specialist who keeps our clients' sites fast, crawlable, indexable, and structured to win, in both traditional search and AI search.



You'll own the technical side of every client account: audits, fixes, site architecture, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and making sure both Googlebot and AI crawlers can read and trust every page. Content and links only work when the technical foundation is right; that foundation is your job.



Law firm sites bring their own technical mess: legacy CMS builds, bloated themes, duplicate practice-area pages, broken redirects from old rebrands, and location pages that cannibalise each other. You'll see all of it, and you'll fix it.



The measure of your work is simple: enquiries for our clients. Crawl stats and site health scores matter, but leads are the result we're paid for.



What You'll Do

> Run full technical audits on client sites: crawlability, indexation, site speed, mobile usability, redirects, duplicate content, and internal linking

> Prioritise and ship fixes, working with our dev team or directly in the CMS where possible

> Own site architecture: URL structure, silo/internal linking logic, and pagination for practice areas and location pages

> Implement and maintain structured data (LocalBusiness, LegalService, FAQ, Attorney/Person schema) and keep it valid

> Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals and page experience across the portfolio

> Ensure sites are fully readable and citable by AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) as well as Googlebot: rendering, robots directives, llms.txt where relevant

> Manage site migrations and redesigns: redirect mapping, pre/post-launch checks, and ranking protection

> Set up and maintain Search Console, rank tracking, and technical monitoring so problems are caught before clients notice

> Report clearly on technical health and the impact of fixes, in language a solicitor understands

> Must-Haves (Non-Negotiable, Read Before Applying)



We get a lot of applications from people with SEO certificates and no real experience. We will not shortlist them. If you cannot prove all five of the below, do not apply.



Proven, hands-on experience fixing real websites. Not audits that sat in a slide deck. You have personally diagnosed and fixed technical issues on live sites (crawl problems, indexation failures, broken redirects, speed issues, rendering problems) and you can show the before and after. Rankings recovered, pages indexed, traffic back. Real sites, real fixes, real results.



Proven experience with the right tools, including Screaming Frog. Screaming Frog is non-negotiable; you use it fluently (crawl configuration, custom extraction, comparing crawls, finding issues at scale). Alongside it: Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse, and a rank tracking platform (we use SE Ranking). Log file analysis experience is a strong plus. If you've never run a Screaming Frog crawl yourself, do not apply.



A proven track record you will be asked to show. Bring real examples to the call: an audit you ran, the issues you found, the fixes you shipped, and what happened afterwards, with numbers. No examples, no interview. "I followed a checklist" is not a track record.



Deep understanding of how technical SEO drives results, not just clean reports. You know which issues actually move rankings and enquiries and which are tool noise. You prioritise by impact. If your instinct is to fix every orange flag in an audit tool before the issues that are blocking indexation, this is not your role.



Deep, end-to-end technical knowledge. Crawling and indexation, rendering (including JavaScript), site speed and Core Web 



Vitals, structured data, redirects and status codes, and site architecture. You can explain why behind every fix, not just what.



Also required:



> Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and enough JavaScript to diagnose rendering issues

title: Senior iOS Fintech QA Tester — Payments, UX & TestFlight

This is not a basic “click around and report bugs” role. We need someone who understands structured QA, payment workflows, asynchronous transaction states, edge cases, mobile UX, and regression testing. Signup, onboarding, login and account recovery

Identity verification and profile management

Home screen, balances and account information



Sending, receiving and adding funds

Domestic and international transfers

Quotes, exchange rates, fees and transfer statuses

Processing, completed, failed, refunded and duplicate transaction states

Membership plans, purchases, restoration and entitlement updates

Cards, savings, crypto and gig-income features

Referral rewards and birthday benefits

Airport lounge search, suggestions, images and booking links

Notifications, requests, transaction history and support flows

Keyboard behavior, forms, validation and long-text handling

Loading states, offline behavior, slow networks and interrupted sessions

App relaunching, backgrounding, crashes and performance

When applying, include

Examples of previous QA reports with sensitive information removed

iPhone models and iOS versions available to you

Your experience testing payments or fintech products

Tools you use for network, performance and crash investigation

Mortgage brokers

Property advisors

Accountants

 & INSTAGRAM

title: ADVERTISING VIDEO CREATIVE SPECIALIST / AI AD CREATOR
description:
ADVERTISING VIDEO CREATIVE SPECIALIST / AI AD CREATOR



Remote | Freelance | As-Needed



$5–$25 Per Finished Video, Depending on Quality, Complexity & Expectations



I am looking for a highly creative Advertising Video Specialist who can create STUNNING short-form advertisements that capture attention, tell a compelling story, and make people remember the product or service.



THIS IS NOT A NORMAL VIDEO EDITING JOB.



I am NOT simply looking for someone to cut clips together, add subtitles, and put music underneath.



I am looking for someone who understands how to CREATE AN ADVERTISEMENT.



The goal is to make someone stop scrolling, become curious, stay until the end, remember the advertisement, and ultimately become interested in the product or service.



ABOUT THE PROJECT



Videos will generally be LESS THAN 90 SECONDS.



You may be given a basic concept, product, service, or idea and expected to turn it into a creative advertisement.



You should be able to take a simple concept and turn it into something much more powerful through:



* Creative storytelling

* Strong hooks

* Interesting visual concepts

* AI-generated content

* Stock footage and images

* Original visuals

* Background music

* Sound effects

* Motion graphics

* Text and captions

* Creative transitions

* Emotional storytelling

* Strong calls to action



The advertisement should feel like something people WANT to watch, rather than something that simply tells them to buy something.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who can think:



"How can I make this person stop scrolling?"



"How can I keep them watching until the end?"



"How can I make them remember this advertisement?"



"How can I present this product or service in a way they have never seen before?"



You should be creative, imaginative, and able to think OUTSIDE THE BOX.



AI tools are absolutely welcome.



If you know how to use AI video generators, AI images, voice generation, animation tools, or other creative AI tools to produce advertisements that look professional and unique, that is a major advantage.



However, AI experience alone is NOT enough.



We care about the FINAL RESULT.



ORTHODOX JEWISH COMMUNITY CONTENT



A significant portion of our advertising projects may involve products, services, businesses, or themes connected to the ORTHODOX JEWISH COMMUNITY.



Previous experience with the Orthodox Jewish community is a PLUS, but it is NOT required.



If you are hired, however, you must be willing to LEARN and conduct appropriate research whenever a project involves this community.



You may need to understand things such as the audience, terminology, culture, values, appropriate imagery, modesty considerations, and the type of messaging that would be appropriate for the specific audience.



You do not need to already be an expert.



What matters is that you are willing to research, learn, ask questions when necessary, and create content that is accurate, respectful, and appropriate for the intended audience.



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



* Experienced advertising video creator

* Strong understanding of marketing and audience psychology

* Excellent storytelling ability

* Creative and highly imaginative

* Understands how to create strong hooks

* Understands viewer retention

* Can create memorable advertisements

* Excellent sense of music and sound

* Can use visuals creatively

* Comfortable using AI creative tools

* Can turn a basic idea into a compelling advertisement

* Extremely detail-oriented

* Able to work quickly and meet deadlines

* Willing to research unfamiliar audiences and subjects



You do NOT need to use any particular software or AI platform.



Use whatever professional tools you believe will create the BEST result.



THE AUDIENCE



Our advertisements may promote many different products, services, businesses, websites, jobs, and opportunities.



Some advertisements may target the general U.S. market, while others may target specific communities, including the Orthodox Jewish community.



You should be able to adapt your creative style to different audiences and products.



HOW TO APPLY



STEP 1 – CONTACT US



Send a WhatsApp message to:




Begin your message with:



"Advertising Video Specialist"



In your message, briefly explain how you understand this project and what you believe makes a GREAT advertising video different from ordinary video editing.



STEP 2 – SEND YOUR TOP 3 SAMPLES



Send your TOP 3 examples of advertisements or promotional videos you have personally created.



Please choose examples that demonstrate:



* Creativity

* Storytelling

* Audience engagement

* Strong hooks

* Marketing

* Product or service promotion



Do NOT simply send random video-editing samples.



We specifically want to see your ability to create ADVERTISEMENTS.



STEP 3 – JOIN THE WHATSAPP GROUP



After your initial WhatsApp message and samples, you will be given instructions to join our WhatsApp group:



After your initial WhatsApp message and samples, you will be given instructions to join our WhatsApp group:



WhatsApp Group:







you will be waiting to join till i approve you. I will only approve those whom videos samples I appreciate



CREATIVE SAMPLE COMPETITION



Inside the group, I will explain a specific advertising concept that I want created.



Interested candidates will have the opportunity to create a SHORT SAMPLE VIDEO based on that concept.



This allows me to see who can actually take an idea and turn it into a compelling advertisement.



The completed sample will be reviewed based on:



* Creativity

* Storytelling

* Attention-grabbing ability

* Viewer retention

* Visual quality

* Music and sound

* Marketing effectiveness

* Overall impact



SAMPLE PAYMENT



This is a PAID SAMPLE.



Each person who actually completes and submits the requested sample video will receive approximately $2 for the completed sample.



The sample payment is intentionally small because this is a short creative test and is NOT the regular compensation for the position.



Everyone who properly completes the requested sample will be paid for their work.



After reviewing the submissions, I expect to select approximately ONE OR TWO people to become our ongoing Advertising Video Specialists.



ONGOING COMPENSATION



The selected video specialists will generally be paid approximately:



$5–$25 PER VIDEO



The exact amount will depend on:



* Quality of the work

* Complexity of the concept

* Length of the video

* Amount of original content required

* AI or other production requirements

* Turnaround time

* Overall expectations for the project



Outstanding creators who consistently produce exceptional advertisements may receive higher compensation and more frequent projects.



IMPORTANT



This is NOT a guaranteed full-time position.



It is an ongoing FREELANCE opportunity.



Projects will be provided as needed.



If you are someone who loves creating advertisements, understands marketing, enjoys experimenting with new AI tools, and gets excited about turning a simple idea into something people remember, I would love to see your work.



We are looking for CREATIVITY, not just technical editing ability.



Want early access to new job opportunities before they are posted here? We sometimes fill roles directly from our WhatsApp group first. Join here to stay updated

title: Amazon Troubleshooting Expert
description:
Position Overview



We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Amazon Troubleshooting Specialist to manage, diagnose, and resolve issues affecting Amazon seller accounts, product listings, orders, inventory, payments, and overall marketplace performance.



The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to investigate complex account and listing issues while working within Amazon’s policies and guidelines.



Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and troubleshoot issues within Amazon Seller Central, including account, listing, inventory, order, payment, and performance-related problems.

* Investigate and resolve listing suppressions, stranded inventory, inactive listings, ASIN issues, category restrictions, and product detail page errors.

* Diagnose account health issues, including policy warnings, performance notifications, intellectual property complaints, authenticity concerns, and other account-related restrictions.

* Prepare and submit appeals, Plans of Action (POAs), and case responses to Amazon Seller Support.

* Follow up on unresolved Amazon cases and escalate issues when necessary.

* Troubleshoot FBA-related issues, including receiving discrepancies, inventory adjustments, stranded inventory, removals, reimbursements, and fulfillment problems.

* Investigate order and customer-related issues, including cancellations, refunds, returns, delivery problems, and order defects.

* Identify and resolve product listing and catalog issues, including incorrect attributes, variations, images, titles, descriptions, and product information.

* Review Amazon account metrics and identify potential issues that may negatively affect seller performance.

* Maintain accurate records of troubleshooting activities, Amazon cases, resolutions, and follow-up actions.

* Coordinate with internal teams such as operations, catalog, customer service, inventory, and management to resolve marketplace issues.

* Stay updated on Amazon policies, Seller Central changes, marketplace requirements, and best practices.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements to prevent future problems.

* Provide clear status updates and communicate complex Amazon issues in an easy-to-understand manner.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Amazon FBA and FBM accounts.

Experience handling account suspensions, listing removals, policy violations, and intellectual property complaints.

Knowledge of Amazon Brand Registry and catalog management.

Experience with Amazon reimbursement claims and FBA inventory investigations.

Familiarity with Amazon advertising and how listing/account issues can affect advertising performance.

Experience working with multiple Amazon marketplaces such as the US, UK, Canada, Australia, or Europe.

Experience using Amazon Seller Central reports and third-party Amazon seller tools.







Work Schedule



* Full-time

* May require flexibility during major sales campaigns, product launches, and livestream events.



What We Offer



* Competitive salary

* Career growth opportunities

* Training and professional development

* Collaborative and innovative work environment
